title: Why does Iran defeat the empires trying to conquer it?
english: The latest episode of the Al Jazeera podcast series Deja Vu explores Iran’s history of successfully resisting various imperial powers throughout the centuries. By examining past conflicts with nations like Russia and Britain, the program analyzes how these external attempts at control have paradoxically shaped modern Iran. Historian Dr. Mehran Kamrava discusses why foreign powers repeatedly miscalculate when trying to dominate the region.
amharic: የአልጀዚራ የፖድካስት ፕሮግራም ‘ዴጃቩ’ አዲሱ ክፍል ኢራን በታሪክ ውስጥ የተለያዩ የዓለም ኃያላን መንግስታትን ተጽዕኖ እንዴት መቋቋም እንደቻለች ይዳስሳል። ፕሮግራሙ እንደ ሩሲያ እና ብሪታንያ ካሉ ሀገራት ጋር የነበሩትን ግጭቶች በመመርመር፣ የውጭ ጣልቃገብነቶች ዘመናዊቷን ኢራን እንዴት እንደቀረጿት ያብራራል። የታሪክ ምሁሩ ዶክተር ሜህራን ካምራቫ፣ ኃያላን ሀገራት ኢራንን ለመቆጣጠር በሚያደርጉት ጥረት ለምን በተደጋጋሚ እንደሚሳሳቱ ይተነትናሉ።
oromo: Sagantaan podkaastii Al-Jazeera 'Deja Vu' jedhamu inni haaraan, seenaa biyyoota gurguddoon akka Iran itti dhiibbaa alaa mo'achaa turte irratti xiyyeeffata. Walitti dhufeenya fi wal-dorgommii biyyoota akka Ruusiyaafi Biriiteen waliin qabdu irraa ka'uudhaan, yaaliin biyyoota alaa Iran to'achuuf godhan akkamitti akka Iran ammayyaatti akka geesse ibsa. Hayyuun seenaa Dr. Mehran Kamrava, maaliif mootummoonni gurguddoon Iran to'achuuf yaalanii dogoggora wal-fakkaatu irra deddeebi'anii akka raawwatan ni ibsu.

title: Barzani says Iraqi Kurdistan wants peace as regional tensions rise
english: Masrour Barzani, the Prime Minister of the Kurdistan Regional Government, has stated that his region remains committed to maintaining peace and avoiding involvement in broader Middle Eastern conflicts. Despite facing frequent attacks during the period of US-Iran regional tensions, he emphasized a desire to prioritize regional stability. He continues to advocate for peaceful diplomatic resolutions to protect the security of Iraqi Kurdistan.
amharic: የኩርዲስታን ክልላዊ መንግስት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ማስሩር ባርዛኒ፣ ክልላቸው ሰላምን ለመጠበቅ እና በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ከሚከሰቱ ግጭቶች ራሱን ለማግለል ቁርጠኛ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ምንም እንኳን በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል በነበረው ውጥረት ወቅት ክልሉ በተደጋጋሚ ጥቃት ቢደርስበትም፣ እርሳቸው ግን የክልሉን መረጋጋት ለማስቀደም እንደሚሰሩ ተናግረዋል። የኩርዲስታንን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅም በዲፕሎማሲያዊ እና በሰላማዊ መንገዶች መፍትሄ መፈለግ እንደሚገባ አስምረውበታል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Mootummaa Naannoo Kurdistaan Masruur Baarzaanii, naannoon isaanii nagaa eeggachuu fi walitti buiinsa naannoo Baha Giddu-galeessaa keessatti mul'atu irraa of qusachuuf murteeffataniiru jedhan. Yeroo walitti buiinsa Ameerikaa fi Iraan keessatti naannichi isaanii yeroo baayyee miidhaa keessa kan ture ta'us, inni garuu tasgabbii naannichaa eeguuf akka carraaqan ibsaniiru. nageenya Kurdistaan Iraaqiif jecha rakkoolee karaa nagaa fi dippilomaasii hiikuu akka barbaadan dubbataniiru.

title: ‘The wealthy poor’: Soaring food prices hurt Iranian families
english: Iranian families are facing a severe economic crisis as food inflation has surged over 100 percent, making basic necessities unaffordable for many. The combination of currency devaluation, regional conflicts, and naval blockades has caused grocery prices to double, forcing even middle-class households to cut back on essential items like meat and high-quality rice. Many citizens now find that their entire salaries are insufficient to cover basic monthly food expenses.
amharic: የኢራን ቤተሰቦች የምግብ ዋጋ ከ100 በመቶ በላይ በመጨመሩ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። የገንዘብ ዋጋ መቀነስ፣ የክልላዊ ግጭቶች እና የባህር ላይ እገዳዎች የምግብ ዋጋ እንዲያሻቅብ በማድረጋቸው፣ መካከለኛ ገቢ ያላቸው ሰዎች እንኳን እንደ ስጋ እና ሩዝ ያሉ መሰረታዊ ነገሮችን ለመግዛት ተቸግረዋል። አብዛኛዎቹ ዜጎች ወርሃዊ ደመወዛቸው ለቤተሰብ የምግብ ፍጆታ እንኳን እንደማያበቃ ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Maatiiwwan Iraan keessa jiraatan gatii midhaan nyaataa dhibbeentaa 100 ol dabaleen walqabatee rakkoo dinagdee cimaa keessa jiru. Gatiin qarshii hir’achuu, waraana naannichaa fi uggurri markabaa gatiin nyaataa akka dachaan dabalu waan godheef, namoonni giddu-galeessa waggaailleen illee akka foonii fi ruuzii jiran bitachuu dadhabaniiru. Hojjettoota baay’ee biratti, mindaan isaanii baatii tokkoof kan ta’u nyaata bituuf illee gahaa miti.

title: Ancient Roman shipwreck discovered off Sicily coast
english: Italian authorities have discovered a well-preserved ancient Roman shipwreck off the coast of Sicily, dating back over 2,000 years. Found by divers following a tip from a local fisherman, the vessel contains hundreds of ceramic jars that were originally used to transport goods like wine and olive oil. Experts from the Italian police are now securing the site to conduct further research on this significant historical find.
amharic: የጣሊያን ባለስልጣናት ከሲሲሊ የባህር ዳርቻ በቅርቡ ከ2,000 ዓመታት በላይ ያስቆጠረ የጥንታዊ ሮማውያን መርከብ ፍርስራሽ አግኝተዋል። በአካባቢው አጥማጅ ጥቆማ የተገኙት ጠላቂዎች፣ መርከቧ የወይን ጠጅ እና የወይራ ዘይት ለማጓጓዝ ያገለግሉ በነበሩ በመቶዎች በሚቆጠሩ የሸክላ ዕቃዎች የተሞላ መሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል። የጣሊያን ፖሊስ ባለሙያዎች ይህንን ታሪካዊ ግኝት ለመጠበቅ እና ተጨማሪ ጥናት ለማድረግ ስፍራውን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa Xaaliyaan qarqara galaana Sisilii keessatti doonii durii Roomaa waggaa 2,000 ol lakkoofsise argataniiru. Qonnaan bultoota fiilmii irraa odeeffannoo argatanii booda, duuboo (divers) dooniin kun gaallaaleen wayinii fi zayitaa zayitii fe'achuuf gargaaran hedduun akka keessa jiran hubataniiru. Poolisiin Xaaliyaan qabeenya seena qabeessa kana eeguufi qorannoo dabalataa gaggeessuuf iddoo sana to'annoo jala oolchaniiru.

title: Netanyahu rejects Trump’s Board of Peace plan for Gaza
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has officially turned down Donald Trump’s proposal for a Gaza peace initiative. He stated that the Israeli military will not leave the region until Hamas has been completely disarmed. Netanyahu emphasized that the suggestions provided by the United States are currently not acceptable to his government.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የዶናልድ ትራምፕን የጋዛ የሰላም እቅድ በይፋ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ሀማስ ሙሉ በሙሉ ትጥቅ እስካልፈታ ድረስ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ከጋዛ እንደማይወጡ አስታውቀዋል። ኔታንያሁ አክለውም አሜሪካ ያቀረበችው ሀሳብ በእስራኤል መንግስት ዘንድ ተቀባይነት እንደሌለው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahuu karoora nageenyaa Gaazaaf Doonaald Tiraamp dhiyeessan fudhatama dhabsiisaniiru. Humnoonni Israa'el gareen Hamaas guutummaatti meeshaa hiikkachuu hanga mirkaneessanitti naannichaa gadhiisanii akka hin baane ibsaniiru. Netanyaahuun yaadonni Ameerikaan dhiyeessite mootummaa isaanii biratti kan hin fudhatamne ta'uu hubachiisaniiru.

title: Indonesia closes national park in East Java as wildfire expands
english: Indonesian authorities have completely shut down access to the Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park due to a rapidly spreading wildfire. Hundreds of personnel, supported by helicopters and drones, are working to control the blaze, which has affected 176 hectares of land. The park remains closed indefinitely to ensure public safety as officials battle difficult terrain and strong winds made worse by an intense dry season.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዢያ በብሮሞ ተንገር ሴሜሩ ብሔራዊ ፓርክ የተቀሰቀሰው የእሳት ቃጠሎ በፍጥነት በመስፋፋቱ ባለስልጣናት ፓርኩን ሙሉ ለሙሉ ዘግተዋል። እሳቱን ለመቆጣጠር በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ አባላት በሄሊኮፕተሮች እና በድሮኖች ታግዘው እየሰሩ ቢሆንም፣ እስካሁን ወደ 176 ሄክታር የሚጠጋ መሬት ወድሟል። በደረቅ የአየር ጠባይ እና በችግር በተሞላው መልክዓ ምድር ምክንያት የእሳት አደጋ መቆጣጠር አስቸጋሪ በመሆኑ ፓርኩ ላልተወሰነ ጊዜ ዝግ ሆኖ ይቆያል።
oromo: Hojjettoonni mootummaa Indoneeziyaa bosonni Bromo Tengger Semeru bifa ariifachiisaa ta'een waan gubachaa jiruuf, daawwattootaaf cufameera. Iddoo kana dhaamsuuf namoonni dhibbaan lakkaawwaman xiyyaara xiqqa (drones) fi helikoptara fayyadamuun tattaaffii godhaa jiranis, lafti hektaara 176 ta'u gubateera. Haalli qilleensa goginsaa fi lafti bakka sanaa tulluu fi dhangala'aa ta'uun isaa hojii dhaamsaa sanatti cimee itti fufee jiraachuu isaa hordofee, iddoon kun hanga beeksisni biraa kennamutti cufamee tura.

title: Israel rejects Donald Trump’s Gaza Board of Peace plan
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has turned down Donald Trump's proposed 15-point peace initiative for the Gaza Strip. Netanyahu stated that Israel will maintain its military presence and continue operations until Hamas is completely disarmed. The government maintains that these actions are necessary to ensure the safety of its citizens and military personnel.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ለጋዛ ያቀረቡትን የ15 ነጥብ የሰላም እቅድ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ኔታንያሁ ሃማስ ሙሉ በሙሉ ትጥቅ እስካልፈታ ድረስ የእስራኤል ጦር ከጋዛ እንደማይወጣ አስታውቀዋል። የእስራኤል መንግስት ወታደራዊ ኦፕሬሽኑን መቀጠል የዜጎቻቸውን እና የወታደሮቻቸውን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ አስፈላጊ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahu yaada furmaata nagaa kan Donald Traamp gaazaaf dhiyeessan qabxii 15 of keessaa qabu fudhatama dhabsiisaniiru. Netanyaahu hamma gareen Haamaas guututti hidhannoo hiikattutti waraanni Israa'el gaazaadhaa akka hin baane ibsaniiru. Mootummaan Israa'el tarkaanfiin waraanaa kun nageenya lammiilee fi waraana isaanii eeguuf murteessaa ta'uu mirkaneessaniiru.

title: La Liga: Five key talking points heading into the 2026-2027 season
english: The 2026-2027 La Liga season begins this Saturday following the recent World Cup. Key narratives include Jose Mourinho's return to coach Real Madrid and Barcelona's ambitious quest to secure a third consecutive league title. Additionally, the league has implemented new regulations to improve game flow by minimizing time-wasting during matches.
amharic: የ2026-2027 የላሊጋ የውድድር ዘመን የዓለም ዋንጫው እንደተጠናቀቀ በዚህ ቅዳሜ ይጀመራል። ዋና ዋናዎቹ አጀንዳዎች የሆዜ ሞሪንሆ ወደ ሪያል ማድሪድ መመለስ እና ባርሴሎና ለሶስተኛ ተከታታይ የሊግ ዋንጫ የሚያደርገው ጥረት ናቸው። በተጨማሪም ጨዋታዎች በሰዓቱ እንዲጠናቀቁ እና የጊዜ ብክነትን ለመቀነስ አዳዲስ ህጎች በውድድሩ ውስጥ ተተግብረዋል።
oromo: Bu'uura tapha La Liga bara 2026-2027 erga xumura Waancaa Addunyaa booda Sambata dhufu eegala. Jiddduu galeessota guguddoo keessaa deebii Jose Mourinho gara Real Madrid fi yaalii Barcelona mootummaa ishee sadarkaa sadaffaa walitti aansitee kabachiisuuf gootuudha. Kana malees, liigichi yeroo tapha keessatti qisaasamu hir'isuuf seera haaraa hojiirra oolcheera.

title: Nigeria mass weddings ease financial burden for couples
english: The Nigerian government is currently hosting mass wedding ceremonies to assist citizens with limited financial means. This initiative aims to help individuals, including widows, orphans, and divorcees, manage the high costs associated with getting married. By organizing these group events, authorities are making it more affordable for low-income couples to start their lives together.

title: Israel rejects Trump's 15-point plan for Gaza, says Netanyahu

title: Houthi attacks in Yemen kill four government troops, say sources
english: Houthi forces launched attacks on government positions along Yemen's Red Sea coast this Sunday, resulting in the deaths of at least four soldiers. According to military sources, approximately 20 additional personnel sustained injuries during the strikes in the areas of Mokha and Khokha. The Houthi group confirmed they targeted military equipment and personnel in the region.

title: Pezeshkian recently met Supreme Leader Khamenei, state media reports
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian held a meeting with Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei in late July to discuss the nation's military and economic strategies. The talks focused on critical issues such as energy management, foreign currency, and international economic cooperation. Despite the president previously noting that communication with the leader can be challenging, officials are working to demonstrate the leader's active presence following reports of his past injury.

english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has formally rejected a 15-point peace proposal for Gaza presented by US President Donald Trump. Netanyahu insists that Israeli troops will remain in the territory until Hamas is completely and verifiably disarmed, arguing that current security threats must be addressed first. This rejection creates a significant challenge for the American-led peace roadmap, which aimed to facilitate military withdrawal and the reconstruction of Gaza.

title: Hundreds forced onto Rome streets amid crackdown on squatted building
english: Around 300 people in Rome have been displaced and are now living on the streets following a government raid on a large squatted building known as Spin Time Labs. Authorities reclaimed the property after a fire occurred there, as part of a broader crackdown on long-standing, self-managed social centers. These residents are facing this forced eviction while dealing with an intense heatwave in the city.

title: Saudi Aramco refinery erupts in flames in Jizan as Houthis claim drone attack
english: A fire broke out at a Saudi Aramco oil refinery in the city of Jizan on Sunday, which authorities successfully extinguished without any reported injuries. While officials did not specify the cause, the Houthi movement in Yemen claimed responsibility, stating they targeted the site with a drone in retaliation for border violations. This incident highlights ongoing regional tensions as Houthi forces continue to strike Saudi energy infrastructure amid intensifying conflict in Yemen.
amharic: በሳውዲ አረቢያ ጂዛን ከተማ በሚገኝ የሳውዲ አራምኮ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ጣቢያ እሁድ ዕለት የእሳት አደጋ ተከስቶ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት ጉዳት ሳይደርስ እሳቱን ማጥፋታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የሳውዲ ባለስልጣናት የእሳቱ መንስኤ ምን እንደሆነ በግልፅ ባይናገሩም፣ በየመን የሚገኙት የሁቲ አማፂያን ጥቃቱን የፈጸሙት እነሱ መሆናቸውን እና የሳውዲ ድንበር ጥሰትን ለመበቀል ድሮን መጠቀማቸውን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ክስተት በየመን እየተባባሰ በመጣው ግጭት መሀል የሁቲ ኃይሎች በሳውዲ የኢነርጂ መሰረተ ልማቶች ላይ ጥቃታቸውን መቀጠላቸውን ያሳያል።
oromo: Dilbata darbe magaalaa Jizanitti bakka buufata ramadan Saudi Aramco keessatti ibidda ka’een miidhaan lubbuu hin qaqqabne, hoggantoonnis dafanii dhaamsuu danda’aniiru. Mootummaan sababa ibiddaa ifa gochuun baatus, gareen Houthii kan Yaman turan xiyyaara nama hin feene (drone) fayyadamuun iddoo sana haleeluu isaanii ibsaniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame duula daangaa Saudi Arabiyaan gaggeessiteen walqabatee akka ta'e gareen sun ibseera. Kuni waraana Yaman keessatti hammaachaa jiru keessatti, gareen Houthii buufataalee inarjii Saudi Arabiyaa irratti haleellaa geggeessaa jiraachuu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Netanyahu says Iran will 'not have nuclear weapons' with or without deal
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has vowed to block Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons. He declared that this policy remains in effect regardless of any international deals or negotiations involving Washington. Netanyahu emphasized that preventing a nuclear-armed Iran is his top priority while he remains in office.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ኢራን የኑክሌር መሳሪያ እንዳታገኝ ለመከላከል ቆርጠው መነሳታቸውን አስታወቁ። ከዋሽንግተን ወይም ከሌሎች አካላት ጋር በሚደረጉ የድርድር ሂደቶች ላይ ሳይመሰረቱ ይህንን ግብ እንደሚያሳኩ ገልጸዋል። በስልጣን ላይ እስካሉ ድረስ ኢራን የኑክሌር ኃይል እንዳትሆን ማንኛውንም እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahuun, Iraan meeshaa niukilaraa akka hin arganne ittisuuf kutannoo qabaachuu isaanii ibsan. Dhimmi kun haala marii biyyoota biraa waliin jiruun ala akka raawwatamu hubachiisaniiru. Isaan aangoo irra jiran hanga ta'etti, Iraan meeshaa niukilaraa akka hin qabaanne gochuun dirqama isaanii ta'uu mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Iran to release footage of Mojtaba Khamenei in the future, says report
english: A senior Iranian official announced that upcoming video footage will show Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei attending public events and meeting with military leaders. This move is intended to address rumors surrounding his health following his absence from public view since taking office. There has been widespread speculation that he sustained serious injuries during the recent attack that resulted in his father's death.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ ባለሥልጣን እንደገለጹት፣ ጠቅላይ መሪ ሞጅታባ ካሜኒ በሕዝብ መካከል እና ከወታደራዊ አዛዦች ጋር ሲገናኙ የሚያሳይ ቪዲዮ በቅርቡ ይፋ ይደረጋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በሥልጣን ላይ ከቆዩበት ጊዜ አንስቶ በይፋ አለመታየታቸውን ተከትሎ ለተነሱት የጤንነት ሁኔታ ስጋቶች ምላሽ ለመስጠት ነው። አባታቸው በተገደሉበት ጥቃት እርሳቸውም ለከባድ ጉዳት ተዳርገዋል የሚሉ ግምቶች እየተሰራጩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Iiraan akka ibsanitti, dura ta'aan biyyattii Mojtaabaa Kaameeneen hawaasa waliin ykn abbootii waraanaa waliin yeroo wal argu agarsiisuuf viidiyoon qophaa'aa jira. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, erga aangoo qabatanii as ifatti waan hin mul'anneef waa'ee fayyummaasaanii irratti shakkii uumamee ture deebisuufi. Isaanis haleellaa abbaansaanii itti du'an sana keessatti miidhaan qaamaa cimaan irra ga'eera jedhamee shakkamaa ture.

title: Russian forces kill several in Ukraine, launch ‘brutal’ attack in Odesa
english: Russian forces launched a widespread series of attacks across Ukraine, resulting in multiple deaths and injuries, including a deadly drone strike on an apartment building in Kharkiv. The campaign also targeted port infrastructure in Odesa, which President Zelenskyy condemned as a deliberate effort to threaten global food security. Meanwhile, Russian officials reported that Ukrainian drone strikes resulted in three civilian fatalities in the Belgorod border region.
amharic: የሩሲያ ኃይሎች በዩክሬን በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ባደረሱት መጠነ ሰፊ ጥቃት በርካታ ሰዎች ተገድለዋል እንዲሁም ቆስለዋል። በካርኪቭ ከተማ የመኖሪያ ሕንጻ ላይ በደረሰው የድሮን ጥቃት የሰው ሕይወት ሲጠፋ፣ በኦዴሳ ወደብ ላይ ያነጣጠረው ጥቃትም ዓለም አቀፍ የምግብ ዋስትናን የሚፈታተን እንደሆነ ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ ተናግረዋል። በሌላ በኩል የሩሲያ ባለስልጣናት በቤልጎሮድ ድንበር አቅራቢያ በደረሰ የዩክሬን ድሮን ጥቃት ሶስት ሲቪሎች መገደላቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Raashiyaa guutuu Yukreeniitti haleellaa bal'aa gaggeessaniin lubbuun namootaa darbee miiidhaan gahuu isaa gabaafameera. Haleellaa dhiheenya Kaarkiv keessatti iddoo jireenyaarratti dhufeen namoota du'anii fi madaa'an booda, haleellaa buufata Oodeesaa irratti gaggeeffameen Prezidaanti Zeelenskiin nageenya nyaataa addunyaa irratti balaa akka qabu ibsaniiru. Gama biraatiin, aanga'oonni Raashiyaa haleellaa xiyyaara raadaara hin qabneen (drone) daangaa Belgoroditti namoonni sadii du'uu isaanii beeksisaniiru.

title: Yemeni army warns Houthis after attacks heighten escalation risk
english: The Yemeni government has officially warned the Houthi movement that it will launch military strikes in response to recent aggression. This decision follows accusations that the Iran-supported group has intensified its attacks on government military installations. These events mark a significant rise in tensions, increasing the risk of further conflict in the region.
amharic: የየመን መንግሥት በቅርቡ በወታደራዊ ካምፖች ላይ የደረሰውን ጥቃት ተከትሎ በሁቲ አማጺያን ላይ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንደሚወስድ አስታውቋል። መንግሥት የኢራን ድጋፍ ያላቸው የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ጥቃቱን በማጠናከር ሁኔታውን ወደ ለየለት ግጭት እየገፉት እንደሆነ ይከሳል። ይህ የሁለቱ ወገኖች ግጭት በክልሉ ያለውን አለመረጋጋት የበለጠ እንደሚያባብሰው ተሰግቷል።
oromo: Mootummaan Yemen, gareen Houthii dirree waraanaatti haleellaa raawwachaa jiraachuu isaatiin walqabatee tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhachuuf akka qophaa'e akeekkachiiseera. Mootummaan kun garee Iran deeggartootaa ta'e kana haleellaa babal'isuu keessatti himateera. Haaloonni kunis waldhabdeen biyyattii keessaa akka daran hammatu fi nageenyi naannichaa akka sodaachisu taasiseera.

title: Houthis say they targeted 'Saudi enemy' forces and equipment in Yemen
english: Houthi forces in Yemen announced they launched a significant military attack against Saudi troops and military equipment near the Red Sea city of Mokha. The group claims to have utilized a combination of drones and ballistic missiles for this operation. Local residents reported hearing explosions in the area following the strike.
amharic: በየመን የሚገኙት የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በቀይ ባህር ዳርቻ በምትገኘው የሞካ ከተማ በሳውዲ ወታደሮች እና መሳሪያዎች ላይ መጠነ ሰፊ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ቡድኑ ጥቃቱን የፈጸመው በበርካታ ሰው አልባ አውሮፕላኖች እና በባለስቲክ ሚሳይሎች አማካኝነት መሆኑን ገልጿል። በአካባቢው የሚገኙ ነዋሪዎችም ፍንዳታዎች መሰማታቸውን ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Humni Hutiin Yemen jiru, magaalota qarqara Galaana Diimaa kan taate Mokha keessatti waraana Saudii fi meeshaan waraanaa irratti haleellaa guddaa raawwachuu isaa beeksise. Gareen kun haleellaa kanaaf boombiiwwan balistikiifi xiyyoottan nama hin feene fayyadamuu isaa ibseera. Jiraattonni naannichaa haleellaa sana booda sagalee dhooyinsa guddaa dhaga'uu isaanii himaniiru.

title: Palestinians in occupied West Bank hold firm on Indigenous Peoples’ Day
english: Residents of the Palestinian village of Umm al-Khair are facing ongoing harassment, land encroachment, and military incursions by Israeli settlers. Despite these pressures, the community is attempting to maintain their cultural traditions, such as weddings, while mourning the death of a local activist. Villagers report that settlers, often supported by military presence, are actively working to displace them from their ancestral lands.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ የምትገኘው የኡም አል-ኻይር መንደር ነዋሪዎች በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰፋሪዎች እና በወታደሮች እየደረሰባቸው ባለው ጫና፣ የድንበር መጣስ እና የግዳጅ መፈናቀል ስጋት ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። ማህበረሰቡ የአካባቢው አክቲቪስት ህልፈትን እያሰቡ በባህላዊ ስነስርዓታቸው ለመቀጠል ቢሞክሩም፣ ሰፋሪዎች ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ እያገኙ የመሬት ወረራ እና የተለያዩ ጥቃቶችን እየፈፀሙባቸው ነው። ይህም የሰዎቹን የአኗኗር ዘይቤ እና ደህንነት ለከፍተኛ አደጋ አጋልጦታል።
oromo: Namoonni ganda Umm al-Khair kan West Bank keessatti argamu, miidhaa fi balleessaa qonnaan bultoota Israa'el akkasumas duula waraanaatiin qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'uuf sodaa cimaa keessa jiru. Hawaasichi kabaja du'a hogganaa isaanii gaddaa jiruu fi sirnoota aadaa isaanii eeggachuu yaalaa yoo ta'u, qonnaan bultoonni Israa'el gargaarsa waraanaan lafa isaanii weerachuu fi jireenya isaanii irratti dhiibbaa uumuu itti fufaniiru. Gochi kun hawaasicha tasgabbii dhabsiisuu fi lafa isaanii irraa isaan ari'uuf kan yaadame dha.

title: FIFA decries ‘concerted’ effort to undermine Infantino as crisis deepens
english: FIFA has issued a statement condemning coordinated attempts to discredit President Gianni Infantino following recent controversies. These tensions escalated after the failure of his proposal to sell commercial rights for major tournaments and allegations regarding his past conduct at UEFA. The organization maintains that Infantino retains the support of its members and insists that any leadership challenges must follow official democratic procedures.
amharic: ፊፋ የፕሬዝዳንት ጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖን ስም ለማጠልሸት የተቀናጀ ጥረት እየተደረገ ነው ሲል በሰጠው መግለጫ አስታውቋል። ይህ ውጥረት የተፈጠረው የዓለም ዋንጫ የንግድ መብቶችን ለመሸጥ የቀረበው ዕቅድ በመክሸፉ እና ከዚህ ቀደም በUEFA ውስጥ በነበሩበት ወቅት የተነሱ ክሶችን ተከትሎ ነው። ፊፋ የፕሬዝዳንቱን አመራር ለመቃወም የሚፈልጉ አካላት በድርጅቱ ህግና ዲሞክራሲያዊ አሰራር መሰረት ብቻ መጓዝ እንዳለባቸው አሳስቧል።
oromo: FIFA pirezidaantii isaanii Jaanii Infaantinoo irratti duula qindaa’aa ta’e gaggeeffamaa akka jiru ibseera. Kunu kan dhufe karoora isaan taphoota gurguddoo irratti mirga daldalaa gurguruuf qaban erga fashaleen booda fi himata waa’ee darbee isaanii irraa kan ka’edha. FIFA akka jedhutti, inni ammas deggertoota isaanii kan qabu yoo ta’u, jijjiiramni kamiyyuu akka seeraa fi sirna demokraasii isaanii kan eeggate ta’uu qaba jedheera.

title: Morocco, Algeria reach WAFCON semifinals and qualify for FIFA World Cup
english: Morocco and Algeria have secured their spots in the WAFCON semifinals after winning their respective quarterfinal matches. By reaching the final four, both nations have also made history by becoming the first African teams to qualify for the 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup in Brazil. Morocco defeated South Africa, while Algeria staged a comeback victory against the Ivory Coast following a crucial red card.
amharic: ሞሮኮ እና አልጄሪያ በየራሳቸው የሩብ ፍጻሜ ጨዋታዎች በማሸነፍ ወደ ዋፍኮን (WAFCON) ግማሽ ፍጻሜ አልፈዋል። አራቱ ውስጥ በመግባታቸውም በብራዚል ለሚዘጋጀው የ2027 የሴቶች ዓለም ዋንጫ የተመረጡ የመጀመሪያዎቹ የአፍሪካ ሀገራት ሆነዋል። ሞሮኮ ደቡብ አፍሪካን ስታሸንፍ፣ አልጄሪያ ደግሞ ተጋጣሚዋ በቀይ ካርድ ከተቀጣች በኋላ መሪነቱን በመቀልበስ ድል ቀናዋታል።
oromo: Morookoo fi Aljeeriyaan tapha raaba xumuraa injifachuun gara gidduu xumuraa dorgommii Waafkoon (WAFCON) dabiraniiru. Gareen lamaanuu gara gidduu xumuraa kan gahan yoo ta'u, biyyoota Afrikaa tapha waancaa addunyaa dubartootaa bara 2027 kan Biraaziilitti gaggeeffamuuf darban jalqabaa ta'aniiru. Morookoon biyya Afrikaa Kibbaa injifatte yoo ta'u, Aljeeriyaan ammoo erga morkattuun ishee kaardii diimaan ergamtee booda taphicha injifachuun milkoofteetti.

title: Why is Pezeshkian urging an end to Iran’s ‘no war, no peace’ status?
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian is seeking to end the current stalemate between his country and the United States, describing the present as the ideal time for a lasting agreement. As part of these efforts, Iran is engaged in indirect talks via Oman to potentially reopen the critical Strait of Hormuz, which has been blocked since the conflict began in February. While Tehran maintains that it is not negotiating directly with Washington, officials are working through intermediaries to address past agreement violations and resolve the ongoing crisis.
amharic: የኢራን ፕሬዝዳንት ማሱድ መዘሽኪያን በአገራቸው እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያለውን የውዝግብ ሁኔታ ለማብቃት ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ይህንን ውጥረት ለመፍታት እና ቀጣይነት ያለው ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ አሁን ትክክለኛው ጊዜ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በኦማን አማካይነት እየተደረጉ ባሉ ውይይቶች፣ ከየካቲት ወር ጀምሮ ተዘግቶ የቆየውን የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ እንደገና ለመክፈት እና የቀድሞ ስምምነቶችን መጣስ ተከትሎ የተፈጠሩ ችግሮችን ለመፍታት እየተሰራ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeshkiyaan, biyyi isaanii fi Ameerikaan gidduutti haalli jiru 'lolaa fi nagaa dhabuu' keessa akka hin turre barbaadu. Yeroon ammaa kun waliigaltee dhimma cimaa furuuf gaarii akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Hanga ammaa karaa biyya Omaan marii taasifamaa jiruun, walitti bu'iinsa ji'a Guraandhalaa eegaleen cufamee kan ture daandii bishaan galaana Hormuz banuuf yaaliin godhamaa jira.

title: Fifa criticises campaign to oust president Infantino
english: Fifa has rejected accusations regarding President Gianni Infantino's personal life, labeling the claims as false and part of a coordinated attempt to weaken his leadership. This backlash occurs amidst growing tension with European football associations, who have expressed a lack of confidence in Infantino following a controversial proposal to privatize commercial rights. Despite calls for his resignation and threats of boycotts, Fifa maintains that its president holds a legitimate democratic mandate and warned critics against using misinformation to force a change in leadership.
amharic: ፊፋ ስለ ፕሬዝዳንቱ  Gianni Infantino የግል ሕይወት የቀረቡትን ክሶች ውድቅ በማድረግ፣ የድርጅቱን አመራር ለማዳከም የታቀዱ የተሳሳቱ መረጃዎች ናቸው ሲል ገልጿል። ይህ ውዝግብ የተፈጠረው የፊፋን የንግድ መብቶች በግል ኩባንያ ስር ለማድረግ በቀረበው አወዛጋቢ እቅድ ምክንያት በአውሮፓ እግር ኳስ ማህበራት እና በፊፋ መካከል በተፈጠረ አለመግባባት ነው። የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት በዲሞክራሲያዊ መንገድ የተመረጡ በመሆናቸው ስልጣናቸውን እንደሚቀጥሉ የገለጸው ድርጅቱ፣ ተቃዋሚዎች መሰረተ ቢስ ክሶችን በመጠቀም አመራሩን ለመለወጥ የሚደረገውን ጥረት አውግዟል።
oromo: FIFA himata jireenya dhuunfaa pirezidaantii isaanii Gianni Infantino irratti dhiyaate kan mormu ta'uu ibsee, himanni kun hogganummaa isaa laaffisuuf yaadamee kan dhiyaate oduu sobaa ta'uu beeksiseera. Wal-dhabdeen kun kan uumame erga FIFA mirga daldalaa isaa dhaabbata dhuunfaatti dabarsuuf yaadee booda, gamtaan kubbaa miillaa Awurooppaa amanannaa isaa dhabuu isaa ibsee booda. Pirezidaantiin FIFA karaa dimokiraatawaa ta'een waan filamaniif aangoo isaanii akka itti fufan kan ibse FIFA, mormitoonni soba fi himata sobaan hogganummaa jijjiiruuf yaaluun isaanii sirrii akka hin taane hubachiiseera.

title: Suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan returning to Ireland in high-security operation
english: Daniel Kinahan, a suspected leader of a major organized crime group, is being extradited from Dubai to Ireland under high security. He is set to face charges in the Special Criminal Court for directing a criminal organization following his arrest in the UAE earlier this year. Irish authorities have implemented significant security measures for his transport and detention to manage the risks associated with his high-profile case.
amharic: የተደራጀ የወንጀል ቡድን መሪ ነው ተብሎ የሚጠረጠረው ዳንኤል ኪናሃን ከዱባይ ወደ አየርላንድ በከፍተኛ ጥበቃ እየተመለሰ ነው። በኤሚሬቶች በቁጥጥር ስር የዋለው ኪናሃን፣ የወንጀል ድርጅትን በመምራት ክስ ቀርቦበት ወደ አየርላንድ ለፍርድ እየቀረበ ነው። የአየርላንድ መንግስት በጉዳዩ ላይ ከፍተኛ የደህንነት ጥበቃ በማድረግ ተጠርጣሪውን ወደ እስር ቤት ለማዛወር ዝግጅቱን አጠናቋል።
oromo: Hoggansa garee yakka gurmaa'e kan ta'e jedhamee kan shakkamu Daani'eel Kiinaahaan, eegumsa cimaa jala ta'ee Dubaay irraa gara Ayirlaandiitti deebi'aa jira. Namichi kun erga Emiireetota Arabaatti to'annoo jala oolee booda, dhaabbata yakkaa hogganuun himatamee mana murtiitti dhiyaachuuf dirqameera. Mootummaan Ayirlaandi nageenya isaa eeguuf fi gara mana hidhaatti geessuuf sochii eegumsa cimaa ta'e taasisaa jira.

title: State of emergency declared as fast-moving Canada wildfire doubles in size
english: A rapidly spreading wildfire in British Columbia, Canada, has triggered a state of emergency after doubling in size and forcing over 20,000 residents to evacuate. Officials described the blaze as incredibly intense and destructive, causing the loss of homes and requiring urgent rescue efforts for trapped individuals. The provincial government has implemented emergency measures to manage resources, restrict travel, and assist in the widespread evacuation of affected communities.
amharic: በካናዳ ብሪቲሽ ኮሎምቢያ ግዛት የተከሰተ ከፍተኛ የእሳት ቃጠሎ በፍጥነት በመስፋፋቱ ከ20,000 በላይ ነዋሪዎች ቤታቸውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ ተገደዋል። እሳቱ መጠኑ በእጥፍ በማደጉ እና ከፍተኛ ውድመት በማድረሱ የክልሉ መንግስት የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ ማወጁን ገልጿል። ባለስልጣናት እሳቱ እጅግ አደገኛ እንደሆነ በመግለጽ የተጎዱ ሰዎችን ለመታደግ እና ሁኔታውን ለመቆጣጠር የተለያዩ እርምጃዎችን እየወሰዱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Kanadaa, British Columbia keessatti ibidda bosonaa saffisaan babal'achaa jiruun lammiilee 20,000 ol ta'an manasaanii gadhiisanii akka baqatan dirqisiiseera. Ibidnichi dachaa ta'ee guddachuu isaa fi miidhaa guddaa geessisuu isaa hordofee, mootummaan naannichaa labsiin yeroo ariifachiisaa akka labsamu taasiseera. Aangoon kun rakkoo kana to'achuuf, carraaqqii lubbuu baraaruu irratti akka bobba'an fi sochii namootaa irratti uggura akka godhan gargaara.

title: From autonomy to 'settler colonialism': How India redrew Kashmir's demographic and political landscape
english: Seven years after India removed the special constitutional status of Kashmir in 2019, the region has undergone significant political and demographic changes under direct rule from New Delhi. New laws have allowed outsiders to obtain residency and purchase land, leading to concerns among locals about the erosion of their rights and increasing economic inequality. While the government claims these policies promote development and integration, residents argue that these measures are systematically disenfranchising the native population.
amharic: ህንድ በ2019 የካሽሚርን ልዩ ህገ-መንግስታዊ መብት ከሰረዘች በኋላ፣ ክልሉ በኒው ዴልሂ ቀጥተኛ አስተዳደር ስር ትልቅ የፖለቲካ እና የህዝብ ቁጥር ለውጦችን አስተናግዷል። የወጡ አዳዲስ ህጎች ከክልሉ ውጭ ያሉ ሰዎች ነዋሪ እንዲሆኑ እና መሬት እንዲገዙ በመፍቀዳቸው፣ በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ዘንድ የመብት መሸርሸር እና የኢኮኖሚ ልዩነት ስጋት ፈጥሯል። መንግስት እነዚህ እርምጃዎች ልማትን እና ውህደትን ለማምጣት ያለሙ ናቸው ቢልም፣ ነዋሪዎቹ ግን እርምጃዎቹ የአገሬው ተወላጆችን መብት የሚያሳጡ መሆናቸውን ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Indiyaan bara 2019 mirga addaa Kaashmir ture erga haqxee booda, naannichi bulchiinsa kallattii Niiw Deelhiin jijjiirama siyaasaa fi uummataa guddaa keessa darbeera. Seerawwan haaroyni namoonni alaa akka naannichatti qabeenya horatanii fi lafa bitatan waan hayyamaniif, uummata naannichaa biratti sodaan mirga dhabuu fi wal-dhibdeen diinagdee dabaleera. Mootummaan tarkaanfiin kun guddinaa fi walitti makamuu kan fidu yoo jedhu, jiraattonni garuu tarkaanfichi uummata naannichaa mirga dhabsiisaa jira jedhanii amanu.

title: IRGC says won't reopen Hormuz until US accepts all Iran's conditions
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps has announced that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until the United States agrees to all of Iran's demands. Officials stated that they now view this vital waterway as a combat zone rather than a simple passage for trade. This decision signals a significant escalation in tensions as Iran uses the route to pressure Washington.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ጦር አሜሪካ የኢራንን ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች እስክትቀበል ድረስ የሆርሙዝ ባህር ወሽመጥ ዝግ ሆኖ እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቋል። ባለስልጣናቱ ይህንን የባህር መስመር እንደ የንግድ ማስተላለፊያ ሳይሆን እንደ ጦርነት ቀጠና እንደሚመለከቱት ገልጸዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ኢራን በዋሽንግተን ላይ ጫና ለመፍጠር እየተጠቀመችበት ያለውን የፖለቲካ ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Raayyaan Ittisa Biyyattii Iraan, hanga Ameerikaan gaaffiiwwan Iraan hundatti waliigalutti, daandii bishaan Hormuz banuuf fedhii akka hin qabne beeksiseera. Hoggantoonni kunneen daandii bishaanii kana akka iddoo waraanaatti malee akka daandii daldalaatti ilaaluu akka hin barbaadne himaniiru. Murteen kun Iraan dhiibbaa Ameerikaa irraan ga'uuf tooftaa fayyadamaa jirtu ta'uu agarsiisa.

title: Talks with US won't happen while interim deal is breached, says Araghchi
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that direct negotiations with the United States are currently paused because of Washington's failure to honor an existing interim agreement. While official talks are halted, both nations are still communicating through third-party intermediaries. Additionally, Araghchi noted that a deal regarding shipping lanes in the Strait of Hormuz is nearly finalized but clarified that the waterway will not be reopened until specific conditions are met.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ ዋሽንግተን ጊዜያዊ ስምምነቱን ባለማክበሯ ምክንያት ከአሜሪካ ጋር የሚደረግ ቀጥተኛ ድርድር እንደሌለ አስታውቀዋል። አገራቱ ምንም እንኳን ቀጥተኛ ውይይት ባያደርጉም፣ በመካከለኛ ወገኖች አማካኝነት መልእክት እየተለዋወጡ መሆናቸውን ጠቁመዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ላይ የሚደረገው የመርከብ መስመሮች ስምምነት መጠናቀቂያ ላይ መሆኑን የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ የውሃ መስመሩ እንደገና የሚከፈተው ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች ሲሟሉ ብቻ እንደሆነ አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbas Araghchi, Ameerikaan walii galtee yeroo gabaabaa cabsuusheetin kan ka'e mariin biyyoota lamaan gidduutti godhamu dhaabbatee akka jiru ibsaniiru. Biyyoonni kun marii kallattii hin qabaatan malee, gargaarsa wal-irraa fageessitootaan wal-qunnamtii gochaa jiru. Kana malee, waliigalteen karaa doonii kan Hormuz dhihoo akka jiru himanii, garuu karaaleen kun banamuu kan danda'an yoo haaloonni murtaa'an guutaman qofa akka ta'e ibsaniiru.

title: Houthis claim attack on Saudi Aramco's Jizan refinery
english: Yemeni Houthi rebels have launched a drone strike against a Saudi Aramco oil refinery located in Jizan. This operation was carried out in retaliation for previous Saudi airstrikes in the Saada and Hajjah regions of Yemen. Saudi officials confirmed that a fire occurred at the facility during the early morning hours, though they did not explicitly link it to the drone attack.
amharic: የየመን ሁቲ አማፂያን በጂዛን በሚገኘው የሳዑዲ አራምኮ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ላይ በድሮን ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ጥቃት በየመን ሳዳ እና ሀጃ ግዛቶች ላይ በሳዑዲ ከተፈፀመ የአየር ጥቃት ጋር በተያያዘ በአጸፋዊ እርምጃ የተወሰደ ነው። የሳዑዲ የኢነርጂ ሚኒስቴር ማጣሪያው ውስጥ እሳት ተቀስቅሶ እንደነበር እና ሰራተኞች ሊያጠፉት እንደቻሉ ቢገልጽም፣ የእሳቱ መንስኤ በድሮን ጥቃቱ እንደሆነ በግልጽ አልተናገረም።
oromo: Finneen Houtii kan Yaman, qondaaltota Sa’udii kan ta’e warshaa cuunfaa boba’aa Aramkoo kan Jizaanitti argamu irratti haleellaa xiyyaara nama hin qabneen raawwachuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame, erga weerarri xiyyaaraa Sa’udii naannolee Yaman kanneen akka Sa’adaa fi Hajjaatti geggeeffame booda haaloo bahuufi. Mootummaan Sa’udii warshicha keessatti gubaan uumamee akka ture fi dhaamsuu danda’uu isaanii mirkaneessus, gubaan sun haleellaa xiyyaaraa kanaan walqabatee ta’uu isaa ifatti hin ibsine.

title: Morning recap
english: Iran has outlined several demands for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, including a request for the US to end military actions against it and its allies. Meanwhile, regional tensions persist with reports of arson in the West Bank, an oil refinery fire in Saudi Arabia, and ongoing military movements in Lebanon. Additionally, international efforts to reach a peace agreement in Gaza remain stalled as both Hamas and Israel dispute the current status of negotiations.
amharic: ኢራን የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን እንደገና ለመክፈት አሜሪካ በእሷ እና በ አጋሮቿ ላይ የምታደርገውን ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ እንድታቆም ጨምሮ በርካታ ሁኔታዎችን አስቀምጣለች። በሌላ በኩል በምዕራብ ባንክ የሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች፣ የሳውዲ አረቢያ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ እሳት እና በሊባኖስ ያለው ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ በአካባቢው ያለውን ውጥረት አባብሰውታል። በሌላ በኩል ሃማስ እና እስራኤል በጋዛ የሰላም ዕቅድ ላይ ስምምነት ላይ መድረስ ባለመቻላቸው የተኩስ አቁም ድርድሩ መዘግየቱ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Iiraan dhimma cufamee jiru galana Hormuz banuuf, Ameerikaan tarkaanfii waraanaa ishee fi michoota ishee irratti fudhatu akka dhaabdu dabalatee haaldureewwan tokko tokko dhiheessiteetti. Gamtaan, weerarri naannoo Qarxii dhiyaa, ibidda dhaabbata gubaa boba'aa Saudii Arabiyaa keessatti ka'e, akkasumas sochii waraanaa Lubnaan keessatti mul'atu naannichatti muddama uumee jira. Gamtaan immoo, Hamas fi Israa'el karoora nagaa Gaaza irratti waliigaluu waan dadhabaniif, mariin nagaa sadarkaa duraan irra ture irraa dhaabbatee jira.

title: It won’t be Trump who kills the ICC
english: The International Criminal Court faces an existential threat from aggressive United States efforts to undermine its authority and shield American citizens from legal accountability. While U.S. political figures have long opposed the court, recent escalations and threats of sanctions have reached a dangerous new level. The survival of the ICC ultimately depends on its member states moving beyond mere words and taking decisive, unified action to defend the institution's independence.
amharic: ዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት (ICC) በአሜሪካ መንግስት ከፍተኛ ጫና እና የህልውና ስጋት ተጋርጦበታል። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት የራሳቸውን ዜጎች ከተጠያቂነት ለማዳን ፍርድ ቤቱን ለማዳከም እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ። ፍርድ ቤቱ ይህንን ፈተና ተቋቁሞ እንዲቀጥል የአባል ሀገራት በቃል ደረጃ ብቻ ሳይሆን በተግባር በመቆም የፍርድ ቤቱን ነፃነት ሊያስከብሩ ይገባል።
oromo: Mana Murtii Yakka Addunyaa (ICC) irratti weerarri fi dhiibbaan gama mootummaa Ameerikaatiin dhufuun bu'uuruma isaa kanneen balaa irra buuse dha. Ameerikaan lammiilee ishee itti gaafatamummaa irraa oolchuuf jecha mana murtichaatti gubuu fi dadhabsiisuuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jirti. Mana murtichis ta'e haqaaf dhaabbachuun kan danda'amu, biyyoonni miseensa ta'an afaan qofaan osoo hin taane, gochaan mana murtichaa akka hin diigamne ittisuun dirqama isaanii bahuu qabu.

title: Women’s Day in South Africa turns 70 with equality still out of reach
english: South Africa is marking the 70th anniversary of the historic 1956 Women's March, where 20,000 women protested against oppressive apartheid-era pass laws. While this demonstration was a powerful milestone for political rights and gender equality, many women in the country still face significant challenges today. Despite the legacy of that brave movement, true equality remains an unfinished goal for millions of South African women.
amharic: ደቡብ አፍሪካ የ1956ቱን ታሪካዊ የሴቶች ሰልፍ 70ኛ ዓመት በዓል እያከበረች ነው። በወቅቱ 20 ሺህ ሴቶች በአፓርታይድ ዘመን የነበሩ አድሏዊ ህጎችን በመቃወም ድምፃቸውን አሰምተው ነበር። ምንም እንኳን ይህ ሰልፍ ለሴቶች መብት ትልቅ መነሻ ቢሆንም፣ በሀገሪቱ ያሉ ሴቶች አሁንም ተገቢውን እኩልነት ለማግኘት እየታገሉ ይገኛሉ። የዚያ ታሪካዊ እንቅስቃሴ ውጤት ቢኖርም፣ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ሴቶች ሙሉ እኩልነትን አሁንም አላገኙም።
oromo: Afrikaan Kibbaa waggaa 70ffaa hiriira dubartootaa kan bara 1956, yeroo dubartoonni 20,000 ta'an seera jireenyaa kan yeroo apartheid mormanii turan kabajaa jirti. Hiriirri kun mirga dubartootaaf tarkaanfii guddaa kan ta'e ta'us, har'as dubartoonni biyyattii keessa jiran walqixxummaa argachuuf qormaata guddaa keessa jiru. Duula ija jabinaa sanaa boodas, dubartoonni miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman ammayyuu walqixxummaa guutuu argachuuf hawwa jiru.

title: Flight cancellations, evacuations as China braces for Typhoon Dolphin
english: China is preparing for the arrival of Typhoon Dolphin, which is expected to bring heavy rainfall and dangerous winds to its eastern coast. Authorities have evacuated approximately 500,000 residents from high-risk areas and cancelled over 1,600 flights to ensure public safety. A red alert has been issued as officials brace for potential floods and landslides caused by the severe storm.
amharic: ቻይና በምስራቃዊ የባህር ዳርቻዋ ላይ ከባድ ዝናብ እና ንፋስ የሚያመጣውን የዶልፊን አውሎ ንፋስ በመጠባበቅ ላይ ትገኛለች። የህዝብ ደህንነትን ለመጠበቅ ሲባል ወደ 500,000 የሚጠጉ ነዋሪዎች ከአደጋ ተጋላጭ አካባቢዎች የተፈናቀሉ ሲሆን ከ1,600 በላይ በረራዎች ተሰርዘዋል። ባለስልጣናት በአውሎ ንፋሱ ሳቢያ ሊከሰቱ የሚችሉ የጎርፍ እና የመሬት መንሸራተት አደጋዎችን ለመከላከል ከፍተኛ የጥንቃቄ ማስጠንቀቂያ አስተላልፈዋል።
oromo: Chaayinaan obomboleessa 'Dolphin' jedhamu kan baha biyyattii irratti rooba cimaa fi qilleensa humna guddaa qabu fiduu maluuf qophaa'aa jirti. Nageenya ummataa eeguuf jecha namoonni gara walakkaa miliyoonaa ta'an naannoo balaan itti uumamuu danda'u irraa kan qe'eetti deebi'an yoo ta'u, balalliiwwan xiyyaaraa 1,600 ol ta'anis haqamaniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa lolaa fi lafti sigigachuu danda'u hordofee balaa mudachuu danda'u ittisuuf akeekkachiisa cimaa dabarsaniiru.

title: Saudi Arabia says fire extinguished at Aramco facility in Jizan
english: Saudi authorities successfully put out a fire that ignited at an Aramco oil facility in the coastal city of Jizan on Sunday. No injuries occurred during the incident, and officials are currently investigating the situation. The Houthi rebels in Yemen claimed responsibility for the fire, stating they used a drone to strike the refinery in retaliation for recent airspace violations.
amharic: የሳዑዲ ባለሥልጣናት እሁድ ዕለት በጂዛን ከተማ በሚገኝ የአራምኮ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ጣቢያ ተነስቶ የነበረውን የእሳት ቃጠሎ መቆጣጠር ችለዋል። በዚህ አደጋ ምንም ዓይነት የሰው ሕይወት አልጠፋም፤ ባለሥልጣናቱም ሁኔታውን እየመረመሩ ይገኛሉ። በየመን የሚገኙት የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የነዳጅ ማጣሪያውን በድሮን እንደመቱት በመግለጽ የጥቃቱን ኃላፊነት ወስደዋል።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa Sa'udii Dilbata darbe magaalaa Jizanitti iddoo suufa qulqulleessu kan Aramco irratti ibidda ka'e dhaamsuuf danda'aniiru. Balaa kana keessatti namni miidhame hin jiru, yeroo ammaa kanattis qorannoon geggeeffamaa jira. Finxaaleyyiin Huthotaa Yemen keessa jiran, weerara kana kan raawwatan immoo iddoo sana darbee darbee qilleensa isaanii cabsuu isaaniitiin walqabatee xiyyaara malee fayyadamuun akka haleelan ibsaniiru.

title: Nagasaki mayor says ‘humanity and nuclear weapons cannot coexist’
english: Nagasaki Mayor Shiro Suzuki recently addressed a memorial ceremony marking the anniversary of the atomic bombing in Japan. He emphasized that the survival of mankind is incompatible with the existence of nuclear weapons. Government officials, including Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, gathered at the Nagasaki Peace Park to commemorate the event.
amharic: የናጋሳኪ ከንቲባ ሽሮ ሱዙኪ በጃፓን የደረሰውን የአቶሚክ ቦምብ ጥቃት መታሰቢያ በዓል ላይ ባደረጉት ንግግር የሰው ልጅ እና የኑክሌር መሳሪያዎች በአንድ ላይ ሊኖሩ አይችሉም ብለዋል። በናጋሳኪ የሰላም ፓርክ በተካሄደው በዚህ ዝግጅት ላይ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሳናኢ ታካኢቺን ጨምሮ በርካታ የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት ተገኝተዋል። የዝግጅቱ ዋና ዓላማ የኑክሌር መሳሪያዎች የሚያደርሱትን ጥፋት በማስታወስ ለሰላም ጥሪ ማቅረብ ነው።
oromo: Kantiibaan magaalaa Naagasakii, Shiroo Suzuukii, yaadannoo bokkaa boombii atoomii Jaappaan irratti raawwate irratti haasaa taasisaniin, namootnii fi meeshaaleen nukilaaraa waliin jiraachuu akka hin dandeenye ibsaniiru. Ayyaanni kun paarkii nageenyaa Naagasakii keessatti kan kabajame yoo ta'u, mummichi ministeeraa Saana'ee Taaka'iichii dabalatee aangawaan mootummaa hedduun argamaniiru. Kaayyoon guyyaa yaadannoo kanaa miidhaa meeshaaleen nukilaaraa geessisan yaadachuu fi nageenyaaf dhaadannoo qabatamaa taasisuudha.

title: World number one Sabalenka upset by Alexandrova at Canadian Open
english: World number one Aryna Sabalenka was eliminated from the Canadian Open after a tough three-set defeat by Ekaterina Alexandrova in Toronto. Although Sabalenka fought back to win the second set, Alexandrova maintained aggressive play to secure the victory in the final set. This unexpected loss creates a setback for Sabalenka as she prepares for the upcoming US Open.
amharic: የዓለም ቁጥር አንድ ደረጃ ላይ የምትገኘው አሪያና ሳባሌንካ በቶሮንቶ በተካሄደው የካናዳ ኦፕን የቴኒስ ውድድር በኤካተሪና አሌክሳንድሮቫ ተሸንፋ ከውድድሩ ውጪ ሆናለች። ሳባሌንካ ሁለተኛውን ዙር በማሸነፍ ወደ ውድድሩ ለመመለስ ጥረት ብታደርግም፣ በመጨረሻው ዙር አሌክሳንድሮቫ ባሳየችው ጠንካራ ብቃት ለመሸነፍ ተገዳለች። ይህ ያልተጠበቀ ሽንፈት ሳባሌንካ ለሚመጣው የዩኤስ ኦፕን ውድድር በምታደርገው ዝግጅት ላይ ተፅዕኖ እንደሚኖረው ተጠቅሷል።
oromo: Ariyana Saabaaleenkaa isheen sadarkaa tokkoffaa addunyaa irra jirtu, dorgommii Kaanaadaa Oopan kan Tooroontoo irratti Ekaterii-naa Aleeksaandroovaan injifatamtee dorgommicha irraa hafteetti. Saabaaleenkaa seetii lammaffaa injifachuun deebitee of haaromsuuf yaaltus, seetii dhumaa irratti Aleeksaandroovaan tapha cimaa taphachuun injifannoo argatteetti. Kufatiin isheen hin yaadamin kun qophii Saabaaleenkaa dorgommii Yuu Es Oopan dhufuuf taasisaa jirtu irratti gufuu ta'eera.

title: Israel announces tender for 627 settler units in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli authorities have issued a formal call for construction bids to build 627 new housing units in the Kochav Yaakov settlement, located in the occupied West Bank. Officials warn that this expansion will further isolate Palestinian communities from Jerusalem and consolidate Israeli control over the area. This project marks a shift from the planning phase to active development, continuing a trend of increased settlement activity seen throughout the first half of 2026.
amharic: የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ውስጥ በሚገኘው የኮቻቭ ያኮቭ ሰፈራ 627 አዳዲስ መኖሪያ ቤቶችን ለመገንባት ጨረታ አውጥተዋል። ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት ይህ መስፋፋት የፍልስጤም ማህበረሰቦችን ከኢየሩሳሌም የበለጠ እንዲገለሉ እና አካባቢውን በእስራኤል ቁጥጥር ስር ለማዋል ያለመ ነው። ይህ ፕሮጀክት ከዕቅድ ወደ ተግባራዊ ግንባታ መሸጋገሩን ያሳያል፤ ይህም በ2026 የመጀመሪያ አጋማሽ የታየውን የሰፈራ መስፋፋት ቀጣይ እርምጃ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el naannoo Qilleensa-Kaaba (West Bank) keessatti, iddoo Kochav Yaakov jedhamutti manneen jireenyaa haaraa 627 ijaaruuf caalbaasii baasee jira. Hojjettoonni mootummaa akka jedhanitti, ijaarsi kun jiraattota Falasxiin magaalaa Yerusaalem irraa fageessuufi to'annoo Israa'el naannicharratti jiru cimsuuf kan gargaaruudha. Sagantaan kun sadarkaa karooraa irraa gara hojiitti ce'uun isaa, waggaa 2026 walakkaa jalqabaa keessa ijaarsi iddoo qubannaa kun jabaatee itti fufee akka jiru agarsiisa.

title: Wildfire forces thousands of evacuations in Western Canada
english: A rapidly spreading wildfire in Western Canada’s British Columbia province has triggered the evacuation of over 20,000 residents. The fire has consumed roughly 9,500 hectares of land, placing numerous homes and farms in immediate danger. Emergency crews are currently working hard to contain the flames as the situation remains critical.
amharic: በካናዳ ምዕራባዊ ክፍል በብሪቲሽ ኮሎምቢያ ግዛት የተከሰተ የሰደድ እሳት ከ20,000 በላይ ነዋሪዎች ከቀያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ አስገድዷል። እሳቱ ወደ 9,500 ሄክታር የሚጠጋ መሬት ያወደመ ሲሆን በበርካታ መኖሪያ ቤቶች እና እርሻዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ደቅኗል። የእሳት አደጋ መከላከያ ሰራተኞች እሳቱን ለመቆጣጠር ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Kaanaadaa gama dhihaa, godina Biritiish Kolombiyaa keessatti ibidda bosonaa saffisaan babal'achaa jiruun namoonni 20,000 ol ta'an iddoo jireenya isaanii gadhiisanii akka baqatan dirqisiiseera. Ibidni kun lafa hektaara 9,500 ta'u barbadeessuun, manneen jireenyaa fi qonna hedduu balaaf saaxileera. Gareen dhaamsitoota ibiddaa haala kanaan dura hin argamin kana to'achuuf halkanii fi guyyaa hojjechaa jiru.

title: Lionel Messi returns to Argentina after father Jorge’s death
english: Football icon Lionel Messi has traveled to his hometown of Rosario, Argentina, following the death of his father and longtime manager, Jorge Messi. Jorge passed away at age 68 after battling a lengthy illness. He played a crucial role in shaping his son's legendary career since he was a young boy.
amharic: የእግር ኳስ ኮከቡ ሊዮኔል ሜሲ የአባቱ እና የረጅም ጊዜ ወኪሉ የነበሩት ጆርጅ ሜሲ ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት መለየትን ተከትሎ ወደ ትውልድ ከተማቸው ሮዛሪዮ፣ አርጀንቲና ተመልሰዋል። ጆርጅ ሜሲ በ68 ዓመታቸው ከረጅም ጊዜ ህመም በኋላ ህይወታቸው አልፏል። እርሳቸው ልጃቸው በልጅነቱ ጀምሮ የእግር ኳስ ህይወቱን እንዲገነባ ትልቅ ሚና ተጫውተዋል።
oromo: Leencaa kubbaa miillaa kan ta'e Lionel Messi, abbaan isaa fi gorsaan isaa waggoota dheeraaf tajaajilaa turan Jorge Messi du'aan boqochuu isaanii hordofee gara biyyasaa Arjentiinaa magaalaa Rozaariyootti deebi'eera. Jorge umurii waggaa 68tti dhukkuba dheeraa erga isaan qabee booda du'aniiru. Isaanis ilma isaanii hojiin kubbaa miillaa isaa akka milkaa'uuf ijoollummaa isaa irraa kaasee gumaacha guddaa godhaniiru.

title: Iran issues new demands as Pezeshkian seeks deal
english: Iran has announced six new, stringent conditions that must be fulfilled by the United States before the Strait of Hormuz is allowed to reopen. These requirements include the lifting of economic sanctions, the release of frozen assets, the withdrawal of American military forces from the region, and an end to attacks on Iran and its regional allies. Iranian officials stated that the reopening of this vital waterway is directly tied to Washington meeting these expansive political and military demands.
amharic: ኢራን የሆርሙዝ የባህር በር ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲከፈት አሜሪካ ማሟላት ያለባት ስድስት አዳዲስ እና ጥብቅ ቅድመ ሁኔታዎችን አስታውቃለች። እነዚህ መስፈርቶች የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀቦችን ማንሳትን፣ የታገዱ የገንዘብ ሀብቶችን መልቀቅን፣ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች ከቀጠናው እንዲወጡ እና በኢራን እና አጋሮቿ ላይ የሚደረጉ ጥቃቶች እንዲቆሙ ያካትታሉ። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት የባህር መንገዱ መከፈት በቀጥታ ዋሽንግተን እነዚህን ሰፊ የፖለቲካ እና የወታደራዊ ጥያቄዎች ከመቀበሏ ጋር የተያያዘ ነው።
oromo: Iraan dhiheenya kana daandii galaana Hormuz banuuf, Ameerikaan haalawwan jaha kan guutuu qabdu ta'uu beeksisteetti. Haalawwan kunneen keessatti kaayyoon dhaabuu adabbii diinagdee, gadi lakkisuu qabeenya Iraan kan qabame, ba'uu waraana Ameerikaa naannichaa fi dhaabuu weerara Iraan fi michoota ishee irratti godhamu kan dabalatuudha. Hoggantoonni Iraan akka ibsanitti, banamuun daandii galaana kanaa guutumaan guutuutti kan hundaa'e fedhiiwwan siyaasaa fi waraanaa kana Ameerikaan fudhachuu ishee irratti ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: ‘Very painful’: Joe Biden’s cancer has spread, son Hunter says
english: Hunter Biden has revealed that his father’s prostate cancer has progressed significantly, spreading to his bones and other areas of his body. The former US president was originally diagnosed with the aggressive condition in May 2025. According to his son, the illness has become extremely painful and has severely impacted the former president's daily physical capabilities.
amharic: የቀድሞው የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት የፕሮስቴት ካንሰር ወደ አጥንታቸው እና ወደ ሌሎች የሰውነት ክፍሎቻቸው መሰራጨቱን ልጃቸው ሀንተር ባይደን አስታውቀዋል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ በግንቦት 2025 በከፍተኛ የካንሰር ህመም መያዛቸው ቢታወቅም፣ አሁን ግን በሽታው ተባብሶ ከፍተኛ ህመም እያስከተለባቸው ይገኛል። ይህ የጤና ሁኔታ በዕለት ተዕለት ህይወታቸው ላይ ከፍተኛ ተፅእኖ እያሳደረ መሆኑንም ልጃቸው ገልጿል።
oromo: Hanter Baayden akka ibsetti, kaansariin piroostateetii abbaa isaa gara lafee fi qaamota biroo irratti babaldhateera. Pirezidantichi duraan baatii Caamsaa bara 2025 kaansarii hamaa kanaan qabamuu isaanii kan beekame yoo ta'u, amma garuu dhukkubichi daran hammaatee fi dhukkubbii cimaa uumaa akka jiru ibsameera. Haalli fayyaa kunis pirezidanticharratti miidhaa guddaa geessisuu isaa ilmi isaanii ibseera.

title: US visa sanctions expose the limits of diplomatic pragmatism
english: The article criticizes recent U.S. visa restrictions on TPLF leaders, arguing that Washington is prioritizing political convenience over justice for victims of atrocities. The author contends that ignoring accountability for genocide to favor diplomatic pragmatism undermines long-term peace in Ethiopia. By failing to address the underlying violence and the need for truth, these sanctions are viewed as a betrayal of international human rights standards.
amharic: ጽሁፉ በአሜሪካ መንግስት በህወሓት መሪዎች ላይ የተጣለውን የቪዛ እገዳ በመተቸት፣ ዋሽንግተን ለፍትህ ቅድሚያ ከመስጠት ይልቅ ለፖለቲካዊ ፍጆታ ትኩረት ሰጥታለች ሲል ይከራከራል። ደራሲው የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀልን ተጠያቂነት ችላ ብሎ በዲፕሎማሲያዊ ስሌት መሄድ በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ ዘላቂ ሰላም ለመፍጠር እንቅፋት እንደሚሆን ያብራራሉ። ለደረሰው ግፍ ተጠያቂነትን ባለማረጋገጥ የሚወሰዱ እርምጃዎች የአለም አቀፍ የሰብአዊ መብት መርሆዎችን የሚጻረሩ እንደሆኑ ይገልጻል።
oromo: Barruun kun dhorkaa viizaa mootummaan Ameerikaa hogganoota TPLF irratti fudhate kan komatu yoo ta'u, Washington haqaa fi dhugaa irratti qabxii siyaasaa akka caalchifatte ibsa. Barreessaan kun, dhumaatii sabaa fi waldhabdee darbeef itti gaafatamummaa osoo hin mirkaneessin, mala siyaasaa qofa hordofuun nagaa waaraa Itoophiyaa keessatti fiduu akka hin dandeenye akeekkachiisa. Tarkaanfiin kun haqa dhabeessa ta'uun isaa fi qajeelfamoota mirga namoomaa addunyaa irra darbuu isaa ibsa.

title: Israel accused of weaponising archaeology at ancient West Bank sites
english: Israeli authorities are seizing approximately 450 acres of land from Palestinians in the occupied West Bank to develop the ancient site of Sebastia into a national park. Local landowners and residents fear this move will permanently alienate them from their ancestral property and cultural heritage. UNESCO has officially designated the area as a World Heritage site in danger, citing concerns that the project could threaten the integrity of the historical location and displace the local community.
amharic: የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በዌስት ባንክ የሚገኘውን ጥንታዊ የሰባስቲያ ቦታ ወደ ብሔራዊ ፓርክ ለመቀየር ከፍልስጤማውያን 450 ኤከር የሚጠጋ መሬት እየነጠቁ ይገኛሉ። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ይህ ድርጊት ከቀዬአቸውና ከባህላዊ ቅርሶቻቸው እንደሚያፈናቅላቸው ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት የትምህርት፣ የሳይንስ እና የባህል ድርጅት (UNESCO) ይህንን አካባቢ በአደጋ ላይ ያለ የዓለም ቅርስ መሆኑን ያወጀ ሲሆን፣ ፕሮጀክቱ የታሪካዊ ቦታውን ይዘት ሊጎዳ እና ነዋሪዎችን ሊያፈናቅል እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el iddoo durii kan Sebaastiyaa jedhamu kan Zoonii Giddu-galeessa (West Bank) keessatti argamu gara paarkii biyyaatti jijjiiruuf jecha lafa Paalastayinoonni abbaa itti ta'an heektaara 450 ol ta'u fudhachaa jira. Namoonni naannichaa lafti kun kan isaanii fi kan akaakayyuu isaanii ta'uu isaa ibsuun, tarkaanfiin kun qabeenyaa fi seenaa isaanii irraa isaan gargar baasa jedhanii yaadda'u. Dhaabbanni UNESCO iddoo kana akka lafa seena-qabeessa diigamaa jiruufi bakka xiyyeeffannoo barbaaduutti ramadee jira; hojiin kunis seenaa iddoo sanaa balleessuu fi uummata naannichaa buqqisuu akka danda'u hubachiisee jira.

title: Hundreds arrested over French wildfires, but who is to blame?
english: France has experienced its worst wildfire season since World War Two, destroying over 300,000 acres of land. While climate change is a major underlying factor, authorities have arrested 420 people for allegedly starting fires, either intentionally or through negligence. Critics, however, argue that these mass arrests may be excessive, questioning whether the government is using these prosecutions to deflect from its own lack of disaster preparedness.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ ከሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ወዲህ እጅግ የከፋውን የጫካ እሳት አደጋ አስተናግዳ ከ300,000 ሄክታር በላይ መሬት ወድሟል። የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ለችግሩ ዋነኛ ምክንያት ቢሆንም፣ መንግስት ሆን ብለው ወይም በቸልተኝነት እሳት ለኮሱ የተጠረጠሩ 420 ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል። ይሁን እንጂ ብዙዎች ይህ የጅምላ እስር ከመጠን ያለፈ እንደሆነ በመግለጽ፣ መንግስት የራሱን ዝግጅት ማነስ ለመሸፈን እየሞከረ ነው ብለው ይተቻሉ።
oromo: Faransaay keessatti gubaan bosonaa waraana addunyaa lammaffaa booda mudatee hin beekne kan mudate yoo ta'u, lafti hektaara 300,000 ol ta'u barbadoofera. Jijjiiramni qilleensaa sababa guddaa ta'us, mootummaan namoota 420 ta'an gubaa kana ofiif ykn waan ofeeggannoo hin qabneef qabdee jirti. Haa ta'u malee, qaoleen tokko tokko qabxiin kun baay'ee cimaa fi sirrii kan hin taane dha jechuun, mootummaan rakkoo qophii dhabuu isaa dhoksuuf kan godhuu dha jechuun ni mormu.

title: Perez Hilton faces long recovery after self-harm livestream
english: American celebrity blogger Perez Hilton is currently in stable but serious condition in a Florida hospital following a mental health crisis. Authorities were alerted by viewers after he livestreamed an act of self-harm, leading to his hospitalization under the state's mental health laws. His family has confirmed that he requires a lengthy recovery period and upcoming surgery following significant blood loss.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ታዋቂ የብሎግ ባለቤት ፔሬዝ ሂልተን የአእምሮ ጤና ቀውስ ካጋጠመው በኋላ በፍሎሪዳ በሚገኝ ሆስፒታል ውስጥ ህክምና እየተደረገለት ይገኛል። ግለሰቡ በቲክቶክ ቀጥታ ስርጭት ላይ እያለ እራሱን እንደጎዳ በሰዎች ጥቆማ መሰረት በፖሊስ ወደ ሆስፒታል ተወስዷል። የቤተሰቦቹ መግለጫ እንዳመለከተው፣ ብዙ ደም በመፍሰሱ ምክንያት በቀጣይ ቀናት የቀዶ ጥገና የሚደረግለት ሲሆን፣ ሙሉ በሙሉ ለማገገም ረጅም ጊዜ እንደሚወስድበት ተገልጿል።
oromo: Blogger-iin beekamaan Ameerikaa Perez Hilton rakkoo fayyaa sammuu mudatee erga hospitaala galee booda, amma haalli isaa tasgabbaa’aa ta’us hamaa dha. Namichi kun erga livestream-ii TikTok irratti of miidhee booda, namoota isa ilaalaa turaniin erga gabaafamee booda poolisiin gara hospitaalaatti isa geessaniiru. Maatiin isaa akka ibsanitti, dhiiga baay'ee waan dhabeef guyyoota dhufan keessa baqaqsanii hodhuu kan godhamuuf yoo ta'u, fayyuun isaas yeroo dheeraa kan fudhatu ta'a.

title: Car bomb hits Colombia highway day after new president sworn in
english: A car bomb explosion severely damaged a toll booth located on a major Colombian highway. The incident occurred on Saturday, just one day after the country's new president officially began his term. Military officials have attributed the attack to splinter groups associated with the former FARC rebel organization.
amharic: በኮሎምቢያ ዋና መንገድ ላይ የተጠመደ የመኪና ቦምብ የክፍያ ጣቢያን አውድሟል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው የአገሪቱ አዲሱ ፕሬዝዳንት ስልጣን ከተረከቡ ማግስት ነው። የጦር ኃይሉ ለዚህ ድርጊት ተጠያቂ ያደረገው የቀድሞው የፋርክ (FARC) አማፂ ቡድን ክፍሎችን ነው።
oromo: Konkolaataan boombii hidhattee ture daandii guddaa Kolombiyaa irratti bakka gatii kaffaltii miidhee jira. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame guyyaa tokko booda pirezidaantiin biyyattii haaraan aangoo erga qabatanii booda. Humnoonni waraanaa haleellaa kanaaf kan itti gaafatamummaa fudhatan garee rebela duraanii FARC kan ta'anidha.

title: Iran seeks way out of ‘neither war nor peace’ stalemate with US
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian is looking to resolve the ongoing diplomatic standoff with the United States by utilizing mediation through Oman. Iran has established specific conditions for improving relations and reopening the critical Strait of Hormuz, which include the removal of American economic sanctions and payment for past war-related damages. This initiative aims to shift the current uneasy state of tension toward a more stable relationship.
amharic: የኢራን ፕሬዝዳንት መስኡድ 페ዘሽኪያን ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያለውን ውጥረት የተሞላበት ግንኙነት በኦማን በኩል በሚደረግ ድርድር ለመፍታት ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ኢራን ግንኙነታቸውን ለማሻሻል እና የሆርሙዝ የባህር በርን ለመክፈት አሜሪካ ማዕቀቦችን እንድታነሳና ለጦርነት ጉዳት ካሳ እንድትከፍል ቅድመ ሁኔታ አስቀምጣለች። ይህ ጥረት አሁን ያለውን የጥርጣሬ ሁኔታ ወደተሻለ መረጋጋት ለመቀየር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeeshkiyaan, walitti bu’iinsa Ameerikaa waliin qaban furuuf karaa Omaan marii gaggeessaa jiru. Iraan hariiroo isaanii fooyyessuufi daandii galaana Hormuz banuuf, Ameerikaan sanciiwwan akka kaastuu fi miidhaa waraanaatiif kaffaltii akka raawwattu gaafatteetti. Karoorri kun haala amma jiru irraa gara nagaa fi tasgabbii qabutti ce’uuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Ghana’s cashew apples get a second life
english: Ghanaian cashew farmers are starting to turn cashew apples, which were previously discarded as waste, into new sources of income. Researchers are developing techniques to process this perishable fruit into various food products like juice and sausages while overcoming challenges like its short shelf life and bitter taste. This initiative aims to help rural communities maximize their harvest gains and create more economic opportunities through better processing infrastructure.
amharic: የጋና የለውዝ አምራች ገበሬዎች ከዚህ ቀደም ይጣሉ የነበሩትን የለውዝ ፍሬ (ካሼው አፕል) ወደ ገቢ ምንጭነት እየቀየሩ ይገኛሉ። ተመራማሪዎች ይህን በፍጥነት የሚበላሽ ፍሬ እንደ ጭማቂ እና ቋሊማ ባሉ የምግብ ምርቶች ለመቀየር እና የጣዕም ችግሮቹን ለመፍታት ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ይህ ፕሮጀክት ገበሬዎች ከምርታቸው ተጨማሪ ገቢ እንዲያገኙ እና የገጠር ማህበረሰቦችን ኢኮኖሚ ለማሳደግ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Qonnaan bultoonni Ganaa kan kanaan dura akka qophiitti gatamaa ture kan 'cashew apple' jedhamu jijjiiranii gara madda galii haaraatti geeddaruuf hojjechaa jiru. Qorattoonni kuduraa dafee badu kana gara dhangala'aa fi soorata garaagaraatti jijjiiruun akkasumas dhadhabbii isaa hir'isuuf mala adda addaa uumaa jiru. Sagantaan kun qonnaan bultoonni bu'aa midhaan isaanii irraa argatan dabaluu fi misooma gandaa cimsuuf gargaara.

title: Hamas says ready to go ahead with Gaza plan
english: Hamas has confirmed its commitment to a US-supported peace proposal that includes disarming its forces and handing control to a new Palestinian governing body. While the group is pushing for international pressure on Israel to move forward, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has distanced himself from the agreement. The situation remains uncertain as Israel denies accepting the specific terms of the current draft.
amharic: ሀማስ በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ የቀረበውን የጋዛ የሰላም እቅድ ለመተግበር ዝግጁ መሆኑን ገልጿል። ይህ እቅድ ታጣቂ ቡድኑ ትጥቁን ፈትቶ ስልጣኑን ለአዲስ የፍልስጤም አስተዳደር አካል እንዲያስረክብ የሚጠይቅ ነው። ይሁን እንጂ የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ መንግስታቸው በዚህ ረቂቅ ስምምነት ላይ አለመስማማቱን በመግለጽ እቅዱን ውድቅ አድርገውታል።
oromo: Hamaas karoora nagaa Gaazaatiif Ameerikaan deggerame hojii irra oolchuuf qophiidha jedheera. Karoorri kun humnoota hidhattootaa fi eenyummaa isaanii mootummaa Falasxiin haaraa hundaa'uuf akka dabarsanii kennan gaafata. Haa ta'u malee, muummeen ministiraa Israa'el Benyaamin Netanyaahuun mootummaan isaanii waliigaltee kana akka hin fudhanne ibsuun shakkii uumeera.

title: Pakistani defence minister calls for 'united military front' against Israel
english: Pakistan's Defence Minister Khawaja Asif has urged Muslim nations to form a collective military alliance to counter Israel. He characterized the Israeli state as a threat to the Islamic world that seeks to divide Muslim countries. Asif emphasized that this united front is necessary to ensure the Palestinian cause is resolved according to their desires.
amharic: የፓኪስታን መከላከያ ሚኒስትር ካዋጃ አሲፍ የእስልምና ሀገራት በእስራኤል ላይ በጋራ ወታደራዊ ግንባር እንዲሰለፉ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። እስራኤል የእስልምናውን ዓለም ለስጋት የዳረገች እና ሙስሊም ሀገራትን እርስ በርስ ለማጋጨት የምትሞክር ሀገር መሆኗን ገልጸዋል። እንደ ሚኒስትሩ አባባል፣ የፍልስጤም ህዝብ ጥያቄ እስኪፈታ ድረስ ሙስሊም ሀገራት አንድ ላይ መቆም አለባቸው።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyya Paakistaan Khawaja Asif, biyyoonni Musliimaa Israa'el irratti duula waraanaa tokkummaan akka gaggeessan waamicha dhiyeessaniiru. Israa'el addunyaa Musliimaaf soda akka taateefi biyyoota Musliimaa wal-lolchiisuuf kan yaaltu ta'uu ibsaniiru. Ministirichi akka jedhanitti, gaaffiin ummata Filisxeem hamma furamuutti biyyoonni Musliimaa tokko ta'uun dirqama ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Saudi Arabia, Yemen condemn attack on UAE oil tanker
english: Saudi Arabia and Yemen have joined several other nations in condemning an attack on a UAE-operated oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz. The UAE blames Iran for the incident, describing it as a dangerous threat to international shipping and global energy supplies. The Saudi government has demanded that Iran put an immediate end to its aggressive actions in the region.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ እና የመን በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ በተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬቶች የነዳጅ መርከብ ላይ የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት አውግዘዋል። የተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬቶች ለጥቃቱ ኢራንን ተጠያቂ ያደረገች ሲሆን፣ ድርጊቱ በአለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት እና በባህር ትራንስፖርት ደህንነት ላይ አደጋ እንደደቀነ አስታውቃለች። ሳውዲ አረቢያ በበኩሏ ኢራን በቀጠናው የምታደርገውን ጥቃት በአስቸኳይ እንድታቆም ጠይቃለች።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaa fi Yaman miidhaa markaba boba'aa kan UAE irratti galaana Hormuz keessatti raawwatame balaaleffataniiru. UAE haleellaa kanaaf Iran kan himatte yoo ta'u, gochi kun nageenya galaanaarratti fi dhiyeessii boba'aa addunyaarratti balaa cimaa akka qabu ibsiteetti. Mootummaan Saudii Arabiyaas, Iran gocha hammeenyaa qabdu kana daftee akka dhaabdu gaafateera.

title: Fire doused at Saudi Aramco facility in Jizan, Saudi ministry says
english: Emergency crews successfully put out a fire that started early in the morning at a Saudi Aramco refinery located in Jizan. Officials confirmed that there were no injuries resulting from the incident. The specific reason behind the blaze remains unknown, though the site has previously been a target for Houthi militants.
amharic: በጂዛን በሚገኘው የሳዑዲ አራምኮ ማጣሪያ ጣቢያ ማለዳ ላይ ተቀስቅሶ የነበረው የእሳት አደጋ በአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች መቆጣጠር ተችሏል። በደረሰው አደጋ ምንም አይነት የሰው ህይወት ጉዳት እንዳልደረሰ የሀገሪቱ የኢነርጂ ሚኒስቴር አረጋግጧል። የእሳቱ መነሻ ምክንያት እስካሁን ባይታወቅም፣ ቀደም ሲል ጣቢያው የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ኢላማ ሆኖ እንደነበር ይታወቃል።
oromo: Buufata qulqulleeffannaa boba'aa kan Saudi Aramco, magaala Jizanitti argamu irratti ganama kanaan ibiddi ka'ee ture dhaamsiiftuun to'atameera. Ministeerri anniisaa biyyattii akka ibsetti, balaa kanaan miidhaan lubbuu tokko illee hin geenye. Sababni ibiddi kun itti ka'e hanga ammaatti kan hin beekamne yoo ta'u, bakki kun kanaan dura xiyyeeffannoo garee Houtii ta'ee akka ture ni yaadatama.

title: Israeli troops enter Lebanese village, erect earthen barrier overnight
english: Israeli forces entered Zawtar al-Gharbiya, a Lebanese village intended to be under the Lebanese army's control, and constructed a dirt barrier blocking its eastern access road. Although local officials reported the midnight movement, the Israeli military claimed they had no information regarding the incident. This development occurs amid ongoing military conflict in southern Lebanon that has caused significant casualties and displacement.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በሊባኖስ ጦር ቁጥጥር ስር መሆን በሚገባው የዛውታር አል-ጋርቢያ መንደር ውስጥ በመግባት የመንገድ መግቢያውን የሚዘጋ የአፈር ግድብ ሰርተዋል። የአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት ይህንን እንቅስቃሴ ቢያሳውቁም የእስራኤል ጦር ግን ስለ ክስተቱ የሚያውቀው ነገር እንደሌለ ገልጿል። ይህ ድርጊት በሊባኖስ ደቡባዊ ክፍል ከፍተኛ የሰው ህይወት እና መፈናቀልን ባስከተለው አጠቃላይ ግጭት መካከል የተከሰተ ነው።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el ganda Liibaanoos kan Zawtar al-Gharbiya jedhamu, kan humnoonni Liibaanoos to’achuu qaban, keessa seenuun daandii gara bahaatti geessu cufuuf qarqara biyyeetti fayyadamanii daangaa ijaaraniru. Hogganoonni naannichaa sochiin kun halkan keessa akka raawwatame ibsanis, waraanni Israa'el garuu waa'ee mudannoo kanaa ragaa akka hin qabne dubbateera. Gochi kun walitti bu’iinsa kibba Liibaanoositti gaggeeffamaa jiruufi miidhaa namoota hedduu qaqqabsiise keessatti kan raawwatame dha.

title: Helicopter crash kills pilot and crew member amid Utah wildfire battle
english: A firefighting helicopter crashed near Richfield, Utah, while battling the extensive Widemouth 2 wildfire, resulting in the deaths of the pilot and one crew member. Due to dangerous fire conditions and difficult terrain, rescue teams were delayed in reaching the wreckage to recover the victims. Despite this tragedy, officials confirmed that firefighting operations will continue, with the blaze currently 24 percent contained after burning over 111,000 acres.

title: National Bank Forces Anbesa Bank Board Re-run, All Incumbents Out
english: Anbesa Bank has appointed a completely new Board of Directors following an intervention by the National Bank of Ethiopia. The central bank invalidated the previous election held nine months ago and mandated a supervised re-run. Shareholders conducted the new vote peacefully at the Adwa Victory Memorial Museum to ensure regulatory compliance.

Filannoon kun hordoffii qajeelfamaa waliin nagaadhaan xumurameera.

title: The Storm Passed, the Freight Bill Did Not
english: A Bishoftu flower farm has successfully rebuilt its facilities after being destroyed by a severe storm last year. Despite this recovery, the business and many other Ethiopian exporters are now struggling with a massive increase in shipping and freight costs. This financial burden is straining the broader economy as businesses across various sectors face challenges with international trade routes.

Rakkoon gatii geejjibaa kun daldaltoota sadarkaa gara garaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuun, dinagdee biyyattii irratti gufuu ta'eera.

title: The Hotel That Housed the OAU Meets the Wrecking Ball
english: The historic Ethiopia Hotel, a notable landmark located on Yohannes Street, is currently being demolished. Crews have started tearing down the conference hall, and the main building is expected to be fully removed by October 2026. Several nearby small shops have already vacated the area to make way for the upcoming site clearance.

Suuqonni xixiqqoo naannichatti argamanis bakka sana qulqulleessuuf jecha gadi lakkisanii bahaniru.

title: Tax on Alcohol, Tobacco Worked. Study Finds That May Be the Problem
english: A recent study indicates that excise tax reforms on alcohol and tobacco products have successfully met their goals of increasing prices and reducing consumption. However, the report highlights that this success creates new economic challenges for the government. Officials are now facing a dilemma as the decline in sales is negatively impacting expected tax revenue.

oromo: Fooyya'iinsi gibira alkooholaa fi tamboo irratti godhame gatii dabaluu fi fayyadama hir'isuun bu'aa argamsiiseera. title: Bus Firms Spend Hundreds of Millions, Hit Bank, Tariff, Charging Walls
english: Three inter-city transport companies have invested 450 million Birr in new buses to comply with updated government fleet requirements. However, these firms are now struggling to manage these massive expenses due to difficult bank financing, high tariffs, and insufficient charging infrastructure. The companies are currently working to replace 1,600 vehicles to meet these strict new transport directives.

Dhaabbileen kunniin qajeelfama haaraa mootummaan baaseen konkolaattota 1,600 bakka buusuuf tattaaffii gochaa jiru.

title: Israeli settler attacks rise as West Bank residents lose land
english: Violence by Israeli settlers against Palestinians in the West Bank is intensifying, leading to significant land loss for local residents. Reports indicate that the current right-wing Israeli government is encouraging this behavior to maintain the support of settler voters ahead of upcoming elections. This ongoing conflict has created a hostile environment for Palestinians living in areas near Bethlehem and across the region.

title: Hungary nominates former Supreme Court chief Andras Baka for presidency
english: The Tisza party in Hungary has nominated former Supreme Court Chief Andras Baka as their presidential candidate to replace the previous leader. Baka is well-known for his commitment to judicial independence and was previously dismissed by the Orban administration for his criticism of government reforms. His nomination is viewed as a symbolic effort to restore the rule of law after the party's recent election victory.
