title: Iran war live: Tehran demands end to US blockade to reopen Strait of Hormuz
english: Iran's Revolutionary Guard has set specific conditions to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, demanding that the United States lift its naval blockade and provide compensation for war-related damages. While Washington is pressing for guarantees to stop attacks on commercial vessels, officials suggest that Iranian leadership has indicated no intention to permanently close the strategic waterway. The situation remains a critical focal point of the ongoing tensions between the two nations.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘብ የሆርሙዝ የባህር በርን እንደገና ለመክፈት አሜሪካ የጣለችውን የባህር ላይ እገዳ እንድታነሳ እና የጦርነት ካሳ እንድትከፍል ቅድመ ሁኔታዎችን አስቀምጧል። ዋሽንግተን በመርከቦች ላይ የሚሰነዘረውን ጥቃት ለማስቆም ቁርጠኝነት እየፈለገች ቢሆንም፣ የኢራን አመራር የባህር መንገዱን ሙሉ ለሙሉ የመዝጋት እቅድ እንደሌላቸው መግለጻቸውን የአሜሪካ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ተናግረዋል። ይህ ጉዳይ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ባለው የውጥረት ሁኔታ ውስጥ ወሳኝ ነጥብ ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Humnoonni Irree Eegumsa Islaamaa kan Iraan, daandii galaana Hormuz banuuf, Ameerikaan blokii galaana irra keesse akka kaastu fi miidhaa waraanaatiif kaffaltii akka raawwattu gaafataniiru. Mootummaan Waashingitan haleellaa markaboota irratti raawwatamu dhaabsisuuf yaalii gochaa jiruus, hoggantoonni Iraan daandii kana guututti cufuuf karoora akka hin qabne ibsuun isaanii gabaafameera. Hariiroon biyyoota lamaanii gidduu jiru hammaachaa dhufuun isaa, daandii galaana kanaa irratti dhiibbaa uumee jira.

title: Turkiye says Mecca defence pact not aimed at Iran
english: Turkiye, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan have signed a new trilateral defense pact in Mecca that features a mutual defense clause similar to NATO’s. Turkish officials clarified that the agreement is not aimed at Iran, noting that it does not name any specific country as a threat. The deal focuses on military cooperation, including joint training, intelligence sharing, and the exchange of defense technology.
amharic: ቱርክ፣ ሳውዲ አረቢያ እና ፓኪስታን በመካ ከተማ አዲስ የሶስትዮሽ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ስምምነቱ እንደ ኔቶ የጋራ መከላከያ አንቀጽ፣ በአንዱ ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሁሉም ላይ እንደተፈጸመ ይቆጠራል። የቱርክ ባለስልጣናት ስምምነቱ ኢራንን ያነጣጠረ እንዳልሆነ እና ምንም አይነት ሀገርን እንደ ስጋት ያልለየ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Turkiin, Saudii Arabiyaafi Paakistaan magaalaa Makkaatti waliigaltee ittisa biyyaalessaa kan sadan gidduutti ta'e tokko mallatteessaniiru. Waliigalteen kun akkuma ka'umsa NATO, biyyoota sadan kana keessaa tokko irratti yoo haleellaan raawwatame, kanneen biroo irratti akka raawwatametti kan ilaalamu ta'a. Abbootiin taayitaa Turkiin akka ibsanitti, waliigalteen kun biyya Iran kan hin ilaallanneefi biyya tokko iyyuu akka diinaatti kan hin ramadne ta'uu beekaniiru.

title: Vance says talks 'make progress' but Iran must make long-term changes
english: US Vice President JD Vance announced that recent discussions with Iran have shown some positive momentum. However, he emphasized that the US is still waiting to see if Tehran will commit to the lasting structural changes needed to improve diplomatic relations. Vance noted that if these long-term commitments are not met, the US will continue its policy of pressure while focusing on securing energy interests for American citizens.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ ከኢራን ጋር የተካሄዱ የቅርብ ጊዜ ውይይቶች መሻሻል እያሳዩ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። ሆኖም አሜሪካ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነታቸውን ለማሻሻል የሚያስችል ዘላቂ ለውጥ በኢራን በኩል እንደሚኖር እየተጠባበቀች መሆኗን አስታውቀዋል። እነዚህ መሰረታዊ ለውጦች ካልመጡ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የምታደርገውን ጫና በመቀጠል፣ ለራሷ የኢነርጂ ፍላጎት ቅድሚያ እንደምትሰጥ አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Itti aanaa pirezidantii Amerikaa JD Vance mariin dhihoo kana Iran waliin taasifame guddina tokko agarsiisus, walitti dhufeenya biyyoota lamaanii fooyyessuuf Iran jijjiirama yeroo dheeraa gochuun ishee ammayyuu gaaffii keessa akka jiru ibsaniiru. Vance akka jedhanitti, Iran yoo jijjiirama barbaadamu kanneen hin taasisne ta'e, Amerikaan dhiibbaa ishee itti fuftee akkasumas fedhii ishee kan anniisaa irratti xiyyeeffachuuf murteessiteetti.

title: Fleet of 56 tankers shipping oil through Hormuz 'covertly', tracking firm says
english: A tracking firm reported that 56 oil tankers are currently moving through the Strait of Hormuz while hiding their locations. These ships are performing secret fuel transfers in the Gulf of Oman to facilitate oil exports from nations near Iran. This method allows the vessels to operate without digital detection while maintaining the regional oil supply.
amharic: አንድ መርከቦችን የሚከታተል ድርጅት 56 የነዳጅ መጫኛ መርከቦች ቦታቸውን በመደበቅ በሆርሙዝ ባህር ወሽመጥ በኩል እያለፉ እንደሆነ አስታውቋል። እነዚህ መርከቦች ከአረብ ሀገራት የሚመጣውን ነዳጅ በኦማን ባህር ውስጥ በድብቅ እያዘዋወሩ ይገኛሉ። ይህ አካሄድ መርከቦቹ የዲጂታል መከታተያ ሳይጠቀሙ የነዳጅ ንግድን እንዲያቀላጥፉ ያስችላቸዋል።
oromo: dhaabbanni markaboota hordofu tokko, markaboonni boba'aa 56 ta'an bakka isaanii dhoksanii gara baha Hormuz keessa darbaa akka jiran ibseera. Markaboonni kunneen biyyoota Arabaa irraa boba'aa fudhatanii, galaana Omaan keessatti karaa dhokataa ta'een wal jijjiirraa taasisu. Adeemsi kun markaboonni kunneen meeshaa dijitaalaan osoo hin beekamin hojii daldala boba'aa akka gaggeessan isaan gargaara.

title: Girl and her father wounded as Israeli drone crashes in southern Lebanon
english: A young girl and her father sustained injuries after an Israeli drone fell near their home in Kfar Rumman, southern Lebanon. Reports indicate the aircraft experienced a mechanical failure while flying over the region before landing abruptly. Local authorities confirmed the incident took place near the family's property.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ሊባኖስ በሚገኘው ከፋር ሩማን ከተማ አንድ የእስራኤል ሰው አልባ አውሮፕላን (ድሮን) በመከስከሱ አንድ ወጣት ልጅ እና አባቷ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ድሮኑ በክልሉ ላይ እየበረረ ሳለ የቴክኒክ ችግር በማጋጠሙ የተነሳ ነው ከቤታቸው አጠገብ የወደቀው። የአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት አደጋው በቤተሰቡ መኖሪያ አካባቢ መከሰቱን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Kibba Libaanoos, magaalaa Kaafar Ruumaanitti xiyyaaronni nama hin qabne kan Israa'el tokko kufuu isaatiin mucayyoon tokko fi abbaan ishee miidhamaniiru. Xiyyaarichi naannichatti barrisaa osoo jiruu rakkoo teeknikaa mudatee erga kufee booda manuma isaanii biratti kan kuse ta'u gabaasameera. Qaamoleen naannichaa balaan kun mana maatii sanaa biratti gahuu isaa mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Israel issues tender for 627 housing units in West Bank settlement
english: Israeli authorities have announced a plan to build 627 new housing units within the Kochav Yaakov settlement located in the West Bank. Construction companies have until the end of November 2026 to submit their bids for this project, which advanced from the planning stage to the bidding process very quickly. This development is part of a broader trend, as officials have released numerous tenders for residential and commercial expansion across various settlements throughout the year.
amharic: የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በምዕራብ ባንክ በሚገኘው ኮቻቭ ያኮቭ ሰፈር ውስጥ 627 አዳዲስ መኖሪያ ቤቶችን ለመገንባት ጨረታ አውጥተዋል። የግንባታ ኩባንያዎች ለዚህ ፕሮጀክት የመወዳደሪያ ሃሳባቸውን እስከ ህዳር 2026 መጨረሻ ድረስ ማስገባት ይጠበቅባቸዋል። ይህ ፕሮጀክት ከዕቅድ ምዕራፍ ወደ ጨረታ በፍጥነት የተሸጋገረ ሲሆን፣ በዘንድሮው ዓመት በተለያዩ ሰፈሮች ውስጥ የቤት ግንባታዎችን እና የንግድ ማዕከላትን ለማስፋፋት በርካታ ጨረታዎች መውጣታቸው ይታወሳል።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el naannoo Qarxii dhiyaa keessatti bakka Kochav Yaakov jedhamutti manneen jireenyaa 627 ijaaruuf caalbaasii baaseera. Dhaabbileen ijaarsaa caalbaasii kanaaf hamma dhuma ji'a Sadaasaa bara 2026tti dorgomuun barbaachisaadha. Proojektiin kun sadarkaa karooraarraa gara caalbaasiitti ariitiin kan ce'e yoo ta'u, bara kana keessa naannoolee kana keessatti babal'ina iddoo jireenyaa fi daldalaa irratti xiyyeeffatan caalbaasiileen hedduun ba'aa turaniiru.

title: Vance says US ‘destroyed’ Iran’s nuclear programme
english: US Vice President JD Vance recently stated that the United States has successfully dismantled Iran's nuclear capabilities and weakened its military forces. Meanwhile, Iran is refusing to reopen the Strait of Hormuz until the US provides compensation and lifts its current naval blockade. These conflicting positions highlight the ongoing tensions between the two nations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ አሜሪካ የአን ኢራንን የኑክሌር መርሃ ግብር እንዳፈራረሰች እና ወታደራዊ አቅሟን እንደገደበች ተናግረዋል። በሌላ በኩል ኢራን የአሜሪካ የባህር ላይ ማገጃ እንዲነሳ እና ካሳ እንዲከፈላት በመጠየቅ ሆርሙዝ የባህር ሰርጥን እንደማትከፍት አስታውቃለች። ይህ ሁኔታ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው የፖለቲካ ውጥረት አሁንም መቀጠሉን ያሳያል።
oromo: Itti aantuun pirezidaantii Ameerikaa JD Vance akka jedhanitti, Ameerikaan sagantaa niwuukilaraa Iraan mancaasuu fi humna waraana ishee dadhabsiisuu dandeesseetti. Gama biraatiin, Iraan hanga Ameerikaan kaffaltii beenyaa kaffaltuufi daangaa galaana ishee irra kaayame kaastutti, karaa galaana Hormuz banuu akka hin dandeenye beeksifteetti. Wal-dhabdeen kun hariiroo biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru kan dhiphise dha.

title: Four killed in helicopter crash in Brazil’s Rio de Janeiro
english: A helicopter crashed in Brazil’s Tijuca National Park, resulting in the deaths of the pilot and three Colombian tourists. The victims, who were part of a family celebrating a birthday, were on a sightseeing tour when the aircraft went down in a mountainous forest area. Following the tragedy, Rio de Janeiro officials are calling for stricter safety regulations and increased oversight of tourist helicopter flights in the city.
amharic: በብራዚል ሪዮ ደ ጄኔሮ በሚገኘው ቲጁካ ብሔራዊ ፓርክ በደረሰ የሄሊኮፕተር አደጋ የፓይለቱና የሶስት ኮሎምቢያዊ ቱሪስቶች ህይወት አልፏል። ልደት ለማክበር የመጡት የቤተሰብ አባላት በከተማዋ በረራ ላይ እያሉ ነበር አደጋው የደረሰው። ይህን ተከትሎ የሪዮ ደ ጄኔሮ ባለስልጣናት በከተማዋ ለቱሪዝም አገልግሎት የሚውሉ ሄሊኮፕተሮች ላይ ጥብቅ የደህንነት ቁጥጥር እንዲደረግ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Brazilii, Rio de Janeero keessatti xiyyaarri helikoptarii bosona paarikii biyyoolessaa Tijuka keessatti kufuun isaa lubbuun namoota afurii akka darbu taasiseera. Namoonni du’an kunneen qajeelchaa xiyyaarichaa fi maatii Kolombiyaa irraa dhalatan kan guyyaa dhalootaa kabajuuf dhufan turan. Balaa kana hordofee, bulchiinsi magaalattii balalii helikoptaraa irratti eegumsi nageenyaa akka cimu fi seerri haaraan akka ba'u gaafachaa jiru.

title: Crews recover 19 bodies from rubble of destroyed Gaza building
english: Civil defense workers in Gaza have recovered 19 bodies, primarily women and children, from the debris of a collapsed building in Gaza City. The search operation lasted four days but was slowed down by a severe lack of heavy machinery, forcing rescuers to rely on manual labor. Currently, an estimated 8,000 people are still missing under the ruins of buildings across the region due to ongoing conflict.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ የሲቪል መከላከያ ሰራተኞች በፈረሰ ህንጻ ፍርስራሽ ውስጥ የ19 ሰዎችን አስከሬን አውጥተዋል። አብዛኞቹ የተገኙት አስከሬኖች የሴቶች እና የህጻናት ሲሆኑ፣ የፍለጋ ስራው ከባድ ማሽነሪዎች ባለመኖሩ ምክንያት ለተከታታይ አራት ቀናት በእጅ ጥረት መከናወኑ ተገልጿል። በአሁኑ ወቅት በጋዛ በጦርነቱ ምክንያት በፈረሱ ህንጻዎች ስር ከ8,000 በላይ ሰዎች የገቡበት ሳይታወቅ እንደሚገኙ ተነግሯል።
oromo: Hojjettoonni ittisa sivilii magaala Gaza keessatti reeffa namoota 19, kanneen baay'een isaanii dubartootaa fi daa'imman ta'an, mana diigame jala baasaniiru. Hojiin barbaacha kanaa guyyaa afuriif kan ture yoo ta'u, maashinoota gurguddoo dhabuu irraa kan ka'e harka qullaa hojjetamaa ture. Ammaaf namoonni 8,000 ol ta'an magaalaa Gaza guutuu keessatti manneen diigaman jala jiru jedhamee shakkama.

title: Israeli forces shell  Gaza areas, raid several West Bank towns and villages
english: Israeli military operations have continued in Gaza with artillery and tank fire hitting multiple locations. Meanwhile, in the West Bank, Israeli forces conducted raids in several towns and used tear gas, affecting residents in the Dheisheh camp. Despite a previously established ceasefire, the ongoing violence has resulted in a significant number of Palestinian casualties, including hundreds of children.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በጋዛ የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች በከባድ መሳሪያ እና በታንክ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን ቀጥለዋል። በሌላ በኩል በዌስት ባንክ በተደረጉ ወረራዎች እስራኤላውያን ወታደሮች እንባ ማነቂያ ጋዝ በመጠቀማቸው የዲሄሼ ካምፕ ነዋሪዎች ተጎድተዋል። ምንም እንኳን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ቢኖርም፣ ግጭቶቹ በመቀጠላቸው በርካታ ፍልስጤማውያን ህጻናትን ጨምሮ ለህልፈት ተዳርገዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'eel gara Gazaatti boba'aa fi taankii fayyadamuun haleellaa geggeessuu itti fufanii jiru. Gama biraatiin, naannoo West Bank keessatti humnoonni Israa'eel magaalaalee adda addaa keessatti duula geggeessaniin, buufata Dheisheh keessatti namoonni gaazii imimmaansuu irraa miidhamaniiru. Waligalteen dhaabbii waraanaa duraan godhame ture jiraatus, haleellaa kanaan yeroo ammaa kana daa'imman hedduu dabalatee namoonni Paalestaayinii baay'een lubbuun darbaniiru.

title: Car bomb attack rattles Colombia after inauguration of hardline president
english: A car bomb exploded at a toll station in southwestern Colombia just one day after the country's new hardline president, Abelardo de la Espriella, took office. The military blames this attack on former FARC rebel factions, and while two guards were slightly injured, the government has vowed a tough response to restore national security. This incident highlights the significant challenges the new administration faces in its pledge to combat criminal groups and narco-terrorism across the nation.
amharic: አዲሱ የኮሎምቢያ ፕሬዝዳንት አቤላርዶ ደ ላ እስፕሪየላ ስልጣን ከያዙ በአንድ ቀን ውስጥ በሀገሪቱ ደቡብ ምዕራብ ክፍል በሚገኝ የክፍያ ጣቢያ የመኪና ቦምብ ጥቃት ተፈጽሟል። የሀገሪቱ ወታደራዊ ኃይላት ጥቃቱን የፈጸሙት የቀድሞው የፋርክ አማፂ ቡድን የተከፋፈሉ አባላት እንደሆኑ ገልጸዋል፤ ጥቃቱም በሁለት የጥበቃ ሰራተኞች ላይ ቀላል ጉዳት አስከትሏል። የኮሎምቢያ መንግስት ሀገሪቱን ከወንጀለኞች እና ከሽብርተኝነት ለመጠበቅ ጠንካራ እርምጃ እንደሚወስድ ቃል ገብቷል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Koombiyaa haaraan filataman Abelardo de la Espriella erga aangoo qabatanii guyyaa tokko booda, bakka gatiin itti kaffalamu tokkotti konkolaataa boombiidhaan dha'amee jira. Waraanni biyyattii akka jedhutti, boombii kana kan qopheessan gareewwan yeroo duraa FARC jedhaman keessaa ba'aniidha; miidhaan salphaan qondaaltota nageenyaa lama irra ga'ees jira. Mootummaan Koombiyaa biyyattii keessatti yakka fi shororkeessummaa dhaabsisuuf tarkaanfii jabaa akka fudhatu waadaa galeera.

title: 'Used as human bait': Leaked image shows elderly Palestinian men before execution by Israeli forces
english: A recently surfaced photograph reveals two elderly Palestinian men from Gaza being held blindfolded by Israeli soldiers shortly before their deaths in November 2024. Reports from journalist Younis Tirawi allege that these men were abducted from Beit Lahia and forced to act as human shields for several days by the military. The account claims the individuals were ultimately killed after being used as bait by the 92nd Battalion of the Kfir Brigade.
amharic: በቅርቡ የወጣ ፎቶግራፍ በኖቬምበር 2024 ከመገደላቸው ጥቂት ሰዓታት በፊት በጋዛ የሚኖሩ ሁለት አረጋዊያን ፍልስጤማውያን በእስራኤል ወታደሮች እጅ ተይዘው እንደነበር ያሳያል። ጋዜጠኛ ዩኒስ ቲራዊ እንደገለጸው፣ እነዚህ አረጋዊያን ከቤት ላሂያ ታፍነው ለበርካታ ቀናት እንደ ጋሻ እንዲያገለግሉ ተደርገው ነበር። ዘገባው አክሎም ወታደሮቹ አረጋዊያኑን በመጀመሪያ እንደ ማባበያ ከተጠቀሙ በኋላ እንደገደሏቸው ይገልጻል።
oromo: Suuraa dhiheenya kana baʼeen, namoonni jaarsolii lammii Palastinii lama taʼan, jiʼa Sadaasaa bara 2024 ajjeefamuun isaanii dura humnoota Israaʼeliin qabamanii akka turan agarsiisa. Gabaasa gaazixeessaa Yuuniis Tiraawii irraa akka hubatametti, namoonni kun magaalaa Beet Laahiyaa irraa butamanii guyyoota muraasaaf akka gaachana namatti fayyadamaa turan ibsameera. Gabaasichi, waraanni Israaʼel ajjeechaa kana raawwachuun dura, namoota kanatti akka meeshaa ittiin nama kiyyeessanitti fayyadamaa turan jedheera.

title: Pentagon orders arms production surge as Israeli-US war on Iran depletes missiles
english: The U.S. Department of Defense has directed weapon manufacturers to speed up production and delivery timelines due to dwindling missile stockpiles caused by the ongoing conflict between Israel and Iran. Officials emphasized that current long wait times are insufficient and have demanded detailed plans from companies to boost output within three weeks. This urgent measure highlights concerns regarding the strain placed on American military reserves.
amharic: በእስራኤል እና በአሜሪካ ከኢራን ጋር በሚካሄደው ጦርነት ምክንያት የጦር መሳሪያ ክምችታቸው እየቀነሰ በመምጣቱ የአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር የጦር መሳሪያ አምራቾች ምርታቸውን እንዲያፋጥኑ አዟል። የመከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ባለስልጣናት ኩባንያዎቹ በ21 ቀናት ውስጥ የምርት አቅማቸውን የሚጨምሩበትን ዝርዝር እቅድ እንዲያቀርቡ ጠይቀዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ክምችት ለከፍተኛ ግፊት መዳረጉን ያሳያል።
oromo: Waraana Israa'el fi Ameerikaan Iran waliin godhaniin meeshaaleen waraana Ameerikaa waan dhumanneef, Pentagon-ni oomishtoota meeshaalee waraanaaf ajaja ariifachiisaa dabarseera. Qajeelfamni kun dhaabbileen kun guyyoota 21 keessatti akkamitti oomisha isaanii dabaluu fi ariifachiisuu akka danda'an karoora akka dhiyeessan gaafata. Tarkaanfiin kun haala jiruun walqabatee qusatni meeshaalee waraana Ameerikaa rakkina keessa akka jiru ibsa.

title: Iran sets conditions for reopening Strait of Hormuz
english: A senior Iranian official has established specific demands that the United States must meet before the Strait of Hormuz can be reopened. These conditions include stopping all military threats and actions against Iran, withdrawing U.S. forces from the area, and providing financial compensation for past damages. Iran has declared that it will not compromise on these requirements during any future discussions or conflicts.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ ባለሥልጣን የሆርሙዝ ስትሬት እንደገና እንዲከፈት አሜሪካ ማሟላት ያለባትን ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች ዘርዝረዋል። እነዚህም አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የምታደርገውን ወታደራዊ ዛቻ እንድታቆም፣ ኃይሏን ከክልሉ እንድታስወጣ እና ለደረሰው ጉዳት ካሳ እንድትከፍል ይጠይቃሉ። ኢራን በጦርነትም ሆነ በድርድር ወቅት ከእነዚህ አቋሞች እንደማትወጣ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Hoggantoonni olaanoo Iraan dhimma daandii galaana Hormuz deebi'ee banamuu irratti haala guutamu qabu ibsaniiru. Haalawwan kunneenis Ameerikaan sodaachisa waraanaa dhaabuu, humnoota ishee naannichaa irraa baasuu fi miidhaa darbeef kafaltii kaffaluu kan dabalatuudha. Iraan marii ta'e waraana keessatti gaaffiiwwan kunneen irraa duubatti akka hin jenne ibsiteetti.

title: Will Pakistan-Saudi-Turkiye defence pact change US strategy?
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkiye, and Pakistan have signed a significant mutual defense agreement that requires them to defend each other in the event of an attack. While the U.S. government has not yet issued a formal response, analysts are divided on whether this pact signals a shift away from American influence or a helpful step toward shared regional security. Many experts believe this deal complicates U.S. goals in the Middle East by potentially undermining the Abraham Accords and the normalization of relations between Arab nations and Israel.
amharic: ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን አንዳቸው ላይ ጥቃት ሲደርስ ሌሎቹ ለመከላከል የሚገቡበትን ወታደራዊ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። የአሜሪካ መንግስት እስካሁን በጉዳዩ ላይ ይፋዊ መግለጫ ባይሰጥም፣ ተንታኞች ስምምነቱ የአሜሪካን ተጽዕኖ እንደሚቀንስ ወይም በአካባቢው ያለውን ሸክም ለመጋራት የሚረዳ መሆኑን በተመለከተ ተከፋፍለዋል። ብዙ ባለሙያዎች ይህ ስምምነት የአረብ ሀገራት እና የእስራኤልን ግንኙነት የሚያሻሽለውን 'የአብርሃም ስምምነት' ተፅዕኖ በመቀነስ የአሜሪካን የፖለቲካ ግብ እንደሚያወሳስበው ያምናሉ።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan, Turkiifi Paakistaan walii-galtee ittisa biyyaalessaa kan yoo tokko irratti haleellaan raawwatame kanneen biroo akka wal gargaaran dirqisiisu mallatteessaniiru. Mootummaan Amerikaa ammaaf ibsa ifaa hin kennine malee, hayyoonni waan kana irratti yaada adda addaa qabu; tokko tokko walii-galteen kun dhiibbaa Amerikaa kan hir'isu yoo ta'u, kaan immoo nageenya naannichaa eeggachuuf kan gargaaru dha jedhu. Hayyoonni hedduun walii-galteen kun hariiroo biyyoota Arabaafi Israa'el gidduu jiru fooyyessuuf yaalame kan 'Abraham Accords' jedhamu irratti dhiibbaa waan geessisuuf, imaammata Amerikaa naannichaa irratti rakkina uumuu danda'a jedhanii amanu.

title: Trump’s Former Lawyer Is Now Attorney General
english: Todd Blanche, who previously served as a lawyer for Donald Trump, has been confirmed as the new United States Attorney General. The Senate approved his appointment by a very narrow margin of 50 to 49. His confirmation has sparked significant debate due to concerns surrounding his past legal work and several ongoing controversies.
amharic: የቀድሞው የዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጠበቃ የነበሩት ቶድ ብላንች አዲሱ የአሜሪካ ጠቅላይ ዓቃቤ ሕግ ሆነው ተሹመዋል። ሴኔቱ በ50 ለ49 ድምፅ ጠባብ ልዩነት ሹመታቸውን አጽድቋል። ሹመቱ በፈጠረው የሕግ እና የተለያዩ አወዛጋቢ ጉዳዮች ምክንያት በሰፊው መነጋገሪያ ሆኗል።
oromo: Todd Blanche, abukaatoo duraanii Donald Trump kan turan, itti gaafatamaa olaanaa bulchiinsa haqaa (Attorney General) Ameerikaa ta'anii muudamaniiru. Senaatiin Ameerikaa sagalee 50 fi 49n giddutti dhiphinaan muudamicha raggaaseera. Muudamichi hojii isaanii darbe fi dhimmoota wal-falmiisiisoo ta'an kanneen biroo irratti komii kaasuun hordofameera.

title: What are the challenges facing the Mecca agreement?
english: Saudi Arabia has entered into a new defense alliance with Turkey and Pakistan to broaden its military partnerships beyond its traditional reliance on the United States. This agreement comes amid rising regional tensions involving the Houthis in Yemen and ongoing diplomatic uncertainty regarding Iran. Experts are now debating whether this trilateral pact can serve as a functional replacement for the security protection previously guaranteed by Washington.
amharic: ሳዑዲ አረቢያ ከአሜሪካ ጋር የነበራትን የረዥም ጊዜ ወታደራዊ ጥገኝነት ለመቀነስ በማሰብ ከቱርክ እና ከፓኪስታን ጋር አዲስ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርማለች። ይህ ስምምነት በየመን ሁቲዎች እና በኢራን መካከል ባለው የክልሉ አለመረጋጋት ወቅት የመጣ ነው። ተንታኞች ይህ አዲስ ጥምረት ዋሽንግተን ትሰጠው የነበረውን የደህንነት ዋስትና በአማራጭነት ሊተካ ይችላል ወይ የሚለውን ጥያቄ እያነሱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan hirkattummaa ishee kan yeroo dheeraa kan Ameerikaa irratti qabdu hir'isuuf, biyyoota Turkey fi Paakistaan wajjin waliigaltee ittisa haaraa mallatteessiteetti. Waliigalteen kun yeroo humnoonni Huutii Yemen keessatti fi hariiroon Iran wajjin walxaxaa ta'eetti kan dhufedha. Hayyoonni gamtaan kun gargaarsa nageenyaa duraan Waashingtan irraa argamaa ture bakka bu'uu danda'a moo miti jedhanii gaaffii kaasuutti jiru.

title: Three Palestinians killed and dozens wounded in Israeli attacks across Gaza and West Bank
english: Israeli military operations and settler attacks across Gaza and the West Bank have resulted in the deaths of three Palestinians and dozens of injuries. In the West Bank, forces raided multiple cities and towns, using tear gas and live fire, while settlers assaulted residents and damaged private property. Additionally, military actions in northern Gaza led to further casualties, contributing to the rising death toll since the ongoing conflict began.
amharic: በጋዛ እና በምዕራብ ባንክ በተፈጸሙ የእስራኤል ጥቃቶች ሶስት ፍልስጤማውያን ሲገደሉ በደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። በምዕራብ ባንክ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በተለያዩ ከተሞች በመግባት እንባ አስነዋሪ ጋዝ እና ጥይቶችን በመጠቀም ሰላማዊ ሰዎችን ሲያጠቁ፣ በሌላ በኩል ደግሞ ሰፋሪዎች በዜጎች ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝረዋል። በሰሜን ጋዛ በተካሄደው ተመሳሳይ ወታደራዊ እርምጃም የሰው ህይወት የጠፋ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ቀደም ሲል ከተጀመረው ግጭት ወዲህ የሟቾችን ቁጥር ከፍ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Hojiin waraanaa Israa'el fi weerarri warra biyya lafaa qabatanii jiran Gaza fi Lixaa Baankii keessatti namoota Falasxiin sadii ajjeesee, namoota hedduu ammoo mii'eessera. Lixaa Baankii keessatti waraanni magaaloowwan hedduu weeraruun gaazii imimmaansuu fi rasaasaan namoota irratti tarkaanfii fudhateera, akkasumas warri biyya qabatanii jiran jiraattota miidhuun qabeenya isaanii mancaasaniiru. Gamtaan Gaza kaabaa keessatti tarkaanfiin waraanaa fudhatame lubbuu namaa kan galaafate yoo ta'u, kunis walitti bu'iinsa kanaan dura jalqabame irraa eegalee lakkoofsa namoota du'anii daran dabaleera.

title: Hormuz talks positive, Oman says, as Iran warns deal would not open strait
english: Oman is mediating talks with Iran regarding the reopening of the vital Strait of Hormuz, which has been blockaded following recent regional conflicts. While officials acknowledge progress in the negotiations, Iran maintains that a full restoration of shipping traffic is conditional on the U.S. meeting specific demands. These requirements include releasing frozen assets and stopping naval blockades, leaving the timeline for any final agreement uncertain.
amharic: ኦማን በቅርቡ በተፈጠሩ የክልል ግጭቶች ምክንያት የተዘጋውን ወሳኝ የሆነውን የሆርሙዝ የባህር መስመር ለመክፈት ከኢራን ጋር በመወያየት ላይ ትገኛለች። ምንም እንኳን የሁለቱም ወገኖች ንግግሮች በመሻሻል ላይ ቢሆኑም፣ ኢራን የመርከብ እንቅስቃሴው ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲቀጥል አሜሪካ በረዶ የሆኑ ሀብቶቿን እንድትለቅ እና የባህር ላይ እገዳዎችን እንድታነሳ ጨምሮ የተወሰኑ ቅድመ ሁኔታዎችን አስቀምጣለች። በመሆኑም ስምምነቱ የሚጠናቀቅበት ጊዜ እስካሁን ግልጽ አይደለም።
oromo: Omaan daandii bishaan galaana Hormuz kan yeroo dhihoo as rakkoo naannichaa hordofee cufame deebisanii banuuf mootummaa Iraan waliin mari'achaa jirti. Mariin kun abdii kan qabu ta'us, Iraan immoo daandichi guututti akka banamuuf Ameerikaan qabeenya ishee qabame gadhiisuu fi uggura galaana irraa kaasuun dirqama akka ta'e himti. Kanaafuu, mariin kun hanga yoomitti akka xumuramu fi daandichi yoom akka banamu ifa miti.

title: At least 200 people evacuated as wildfire rages near Lake Garda
english: A wildfire has erupted near Lake Garda in Italy, forcing the emergency evacuation of at least 200 people. The blaze began in the Tignale area, located on the lake's western shore. Authorities are working to manage the situation in this popular tourist region.
amharic: በጣሊያን ጋርዳ ሐይቅ አቅራቢያ በተነሳ የእሳት ቃጠሎ ምክንያት ቢያንስ 200 ሰዎች ከአካባቢው ለቀው እንዲወጡ ተደርገዋል። እሳቱ የተነሳው በሐይቁ ምዕራባዊ ክፍል በሚገኘው ቲኛሌ በተባለች ከተማ ነው። ባለስልጣናት በቱሪስቶች ዘንድ ተወዳጅ በሆነው በዚህ አካባቢ የተቀሰቀሰውን እሳት ለመቆጣጠር ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Itaaliyaatti, ziqqoo haroo Gaardaatti ibidda hammaataa ka'een walqabatee namoonni 200 ol ta'an naannichaa gadhiisanii akka bahan dirqamaniru. Ibidni kun kan jalqabe kutaalee lixaa haroo sanaa kan taate magaalattii Tiiniyaale keessatti. Aangoonni mootummaa naannoo tuuristoonni baay'inaan itti walgahanii kan ta'e kana keessatti ibidda kana dhaamsuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: Lebanese soldiers injured while Israeli troops intrude on southern town
english: Three Lebanese soldiers were injured while clearing unexploded explosives in the village of Zawtar al-Gharbiyah. This incident occurred shortly after reports that Israeli forces had entered the area and constructed an earthen barrier, which local officials described as a violation of a recent security agreement. While the Israeli military claims it has no knowledge of the event, the village is a key pilot zone designated for the return of displaced residents under a US-backed peace framework.
amharic: በዛውታር አል-ጋርቢያ መንደር ያልፈነዱ ፈንጂዎችን በማፅዳት ላይ የነበሩ ሶስት የሊባኖስ ወታደሮች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ይህ የተፈጠረው የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ወደ አካባቢው በመግባት የመሬት መከላከያ ግንባታ ማካሄዳቸውን ተከትሎ ሲሆን፣ የሀገር ውስጥ ባለስልጣናት ድርጊቱን የቅርብ ጊዜ የፀጥታ ስምምነት ጥሰት ነው ብለውታል። የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ክፍል ስለ ጉዳዩ እንደማያውቅ ቢገልጽም፣ መንደሯ በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ በተደረገ የሰላም ስምምነት መሰረት ተፈናቃዮች ወደ ቀያቸው እንዲመለሱ ከተመረጡት ቁልፍ አካባቢዎች አንዷ ናት።
oromo: Godina Zawtar al-Gharbiyah keessatti loltoonni Libanoos sadii otoo meeshaa waraanaa hin dhoonye of irraa kaasaa jiranuu miidhaan irra gaheera. Kunis kan ta'e erga waraanni Israa'el ganda kana keessa seenee daangaa lafaa ijaaree booda; hoggantoonni naannichaa gocha kana caba waliigaltee nageenyaa isaan jedhaniiru. Waraanni Israa'el waa'ee taatee kanaa akka hin beekne ibsatees, gandi kun waliigaltee Ameerikaan deggeramee fi uummati buqqa'e itti deebi'uuf karoorfame keessaa bakka ijoo dha.

title: US slams Chinese ‘nature reserve’ as effort to claim South China Sea
english: The United States has condemned China for labeling the Scarborough Reef a 'nature reserve,' describing it as a deceptive tactic to block Filipino fishermen from their traditional waters. The U.S. stated that Beijing is using environmental excuses to reinforce its illegal territorial claims in the South China Sea. Washington reaffirmed its support for the Philippines, emphasizing the importance of maintaining an open and peaceful Indo-Pacific region.
amharic: አሜሪካ ቻይና ስካርቦሮ ሪፍ የተባለውን አካባቢ 'የተፈጥሮ መጠለያ' በማለት መሰየሟን ተቃውማለች። ይህ ድርጊት የፊሊፒንስ ዓሣ አጥማጆች ወደ ባህላዊ የዓሣ ማጥመጃ ቦታቸው እንዳይገቡ ለመከልከል የተደረገ የማታለያ ስልት መሆኑን አሜሪካ ገልጻለች። በደቡብ ቻይና ባህር ላይ የራሷን የይገባኛል ጥያቄ ለማስከበር ቻይና የአካባቢ ጥበቃን እንደ ሽፋን እየተጠቀመች እንደሆነ የገለጸችው አሜሪካ፣ ከፊሊፒንስ ጎን መሆኗን አረጋግጣለች።
oromo: Amerikaa Itoophiyaa kan taate Chaayinaan naannoo iskaarborooriif jedhamu 'bakka eegumsa uumamaa' jechuun moggaasuushee balaaleffatteetti. Gochi kun qaqqabamummaa qurxummii qabattoota Filippiins kan daangessuufi lafa bishaanichaa harka ishee galchuuf kan karoorfame ta'uu Ameerikaan beeksisteetti. Chaayinaan aangoo ishee babal'isuuf sababa qilleensaafi naannoo fayyadamuu ishee kan mormite Ameerikaan, mootummaa Filippiins cinaa akka dhaabbattu mirkaneessiteetti.

title: ‘Debilitating’: Hunter Biden speaks out about father Joe Biden’s cancer
english: Hunter Biden recently shared that his father, former President Joe Biden, is suffering from painful, advanced prostate cancer that has spread to his bones. During a television interview, the younger Biden expressed deep sadness over his father's deteriorating health condition. Joe Biden was diagnosed with the aggressive illness in May 2025, several months after he decided to withdraw from the 2024 presidential election following concerns about his health and performance.
amharic: ሃንተር ባይደን የቅርብ ጊዜ ባደረጉት ቃለ መጠይቅ አባታቸው የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ጆ ባይደን በአደገኛ የፕሮስቴት ካንሰር እየተሰቃዩ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። የካንሰር በሽታው ወደ አጥንታቸው በመዛመቱ ከፍተኛ ህመም እየፈጠረባቸው እንደሆነም አስረድተዋል። ጆ ባይደን ይህንን ህመም በግንቦት 2025 ያወቁት ከምርጫ ውድድር ከተገለሉ ከወራት በኋላ ሲሆን፣ ህመሙም በአሁኑ ወቅት የከፋ ደረጃ ላይ መድረሱን የልጃቸው ገለጻ ያሳያል።
oromo: Hanter Baayiden dhiheenya kana akka ibsetti, abbaan isaa kan ta'an duraan pirezidaantii kan turan Joo Baayiden, dhukkuba kaansarii piroosteetii cimaa gara lafeetti darbe irratti argamee akka dararamaa jiran ibseera. Innis haalli fayyaa isaanii baay'ee ulfaataa fi gaddisiisaa akka ta'e gabaaseera. Joo Baayiden dhukkubicha kan beekan ji'a Waxabajjii bara 2025 yoo ta'u, kunis erga isaan dorgommii filannoo pirezidaantumii 2024 keessaa ba'anii booda kan mudatedha.

title: Yemen’s government forces attack Houthis amid renewed shelling of Marib
english: Yemeni government forces have launched a retaliatory offensive against Houthi positions following a series of deadly missile and drone attacks on Marib and Hadramout. This escalation, which follows the expiration of a long-standing truce, has caused significant civilian casualties and sparked fears of a return to full-scale civil war. Experts are warning that these renewed clashes indicate a dangerous shift toward broader instability in the region.
amharic: የየመን የመንግስት ኃይሎች በማሪብ እና በሃድራሞት ከተሞች በሁቲዎች ላይ ከደረሰ ገዳይ የድሮን እና የሚሳኤል ጥቃት በኋላ አጸፋዊ እርምጃ መውሰዳቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የረጅም ጊዜ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱ ካበቃ በኋላ የተከሰተው ይህ ግጭት ለብዙ ሰላማዊ ሰዎች ሞትና መቁሰል ምክንያት ሆኗል። ባለሙያዎች አሁን እየታየ ያለው ውጥረት አገሪቱን ወደ ቀድሞው የርስ በርስ ጦርነት ሊመልሳት እንደሚችል ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Humnooni mootummaa Yemen haleellaa xiyyaaraa fi meeshaa waraanaa gareen Huutii Maribii fi Hadraamootitti raawwate hordofee tarkaanfii deebii fudhachuu eegalaniiru. Waraansi kun erga waliigalteen tasgabbii dhaabbatee booda kan ka'e yoo ta'u, lubbuu namoota nagaa hedduu galaafatee fi waraana bal'aa deebinee gannu sodaa uumeera. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, walitti bu'iinsi kun biyyattii gara waraana waggoota hedduu turuu danda'u tokkootti deebisuu akka danda'u akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Turkey says Saudi-Pakistan defence pact mirrors NATO’s Article 5, Egypt could also join
english: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan have formed a new defense alliance that functions like NATO's mutual defense clause, requiring members to support each other during threats. The agreement includes a specialized secretariat based in Saudi Arabia and a ministerial committee to manage strategic decisions. Officials have clarified that this pact is not directed at Iran and noted that Egypt may be invited to join the partnership in the future.

english: A group of social media influencers is actively challenging UK politician Nigel Farage by fact-checking his claims regarding immigration. This movement follows Farage’s resignation as an MP, which was prompted by an investigation into his personal finances.

title: Gaza health chief urges action to ‘save’ Dr Abu Safia before it’s too late
english: Gaza’s health ministry chief is calling for immediate intervention to protect Dr. Hussam Abu Safia, who is being held by Israeli authorities. The pediatrician, who led Kamal Adwan Hospital, has reportedly suffered severe injuries due to torture and lacks essential medical attention in detention. Health officials and human rights groups are demanding his urgent release and immediate medical care, holding Israeli forces responsible for his deteriorating condition.

title: British Columbia issues evacuation orders ahead of fast-moving wildfires
english: British Columbia has declared a state of emergency as intense, out-of-control wildfires force thousands of residents to evacuate their homes. The fires have disrupted power and water services, causing significant damage in districts like Summerland. Officials continue to manage the crisis while scientists attribute the increased frequency and severity of these blazes to climate change and extreme heat.

title: Serbia and Ukraine pledge closer economic ties, eye free trade deal
english: Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy have met in Belgrade to strengthen economic ties and finalize a long-delayed free trade deal by the end of the year. During the visit, Serbia pledged to assist in the reconstruction of Ukrainian cities and support Ukraine's integration into the European Union. While both nations maintained their respective positions on regional sovereignty issues, they agreed to increase cooperation on infrastructure and humanitarian aid.

title: Saudi-Pakistan-Turkiye pact: A new shield or strategic signal?
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkiye, and Pakistan have signed the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement, a new pact where an attack on one nation is considered an attack on all three. Although officials state the treaty is not aimed at any specific country, analysts suggest it serves as a strategic move to deter regional threats amid the ongoing US-Israel conflict with Iran. The agreement combines Pakistan's manpower and Saudi funding with Turkiye's advanced military industry to bolster collective regional security.

title: US Vice President confirms direct US-Iran talks over Strait of Hormuz
english: US Vice President JD Vance has announced that the Trump administration is engaging in direct negotiations with Iran to ensure consistent oil and gas shipments through the Strait of Hormuz. While maintaining economic and military pressure on Tehran, officials are observing if the country will commit to significant long-term reforms. The primary goal of these efforts is to stabilize global energy supplies and lower fuel costs for the American public.

title: France shuts mosque over Quran verses and Islamic texts used in Muslim worship
english: A French court has upheld a six-month closure order for the Chanteloup mosque near Paris, ruling that the state's restrictions on religious teachings are lawful. Authorities targeted the mosque because imams referenced Quranic verses and traditional Islamic texts during their sermons. Legal representatives for the mosque argue that this decision infringes on religious freedom and plan to appeal the ruling to the Council of State.

Gareen abukaattoota masjiidichaa murtoon kun bilisummaa amantii kan sarbu ta'uu ibsuun, gara mana murtii olaanaatti ol-iyyannoo galchuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: Messi's father Jorge dies aged 68 after illness
english: Jorge Messi, the father and long-term agent of football star Lionel Messi, has passed away in his home city of Rosario at age 68 following a lengthy illness. He played a crucial role in his son's legendary career, supporting him from his early days at Newell's Old Boys to his global success with Barcelona and the Argentina national team. The football community, including his former clubs, has expressed condolences to the Messi family during this difficult time.
amharic: የእግር ኳስ ኮከቡ ሊዮኔል ሜሲ አባት እና የረጅም ጊዜ ወኪል የነበሩት ሆርሄ ሜሲ በ68 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይተዋል። በልጃቸው የላቀ የስፖርት ጉዞ ላይ ትልቅ አስተዋጽኦ የነበራቸው ሆርሄ፣ ከልጅነቱ ጀምሮ እስካሁን ድረስ ባደረገው የሙያ ስኬት ጎን በመሆን ድጋፍ ያደርጉለት ነበር። የእግር ኳስ ቤተሰቡ እና የቀድሞ ክለቦቹ ለቤተሰቦቻቸው መጽናናትን ተመኝተዋል።
oromo: Abbaan fi bakka bu'aan taphataa kubbaa miillaa beekamaa Lionel Messi kan ta'an Jorge Messi dhukkuba booda umuriin isaanii waggaa 68 tti addunyaa kana irraa du'aan boqotaniiru. Jorge guddinaa fi milkaa'ina ilma isaanii keessatti gahee olaanaa kan qaban yoo ta'u, jalqaba irraa eegalee hanga injifannoo addunyaa irratti gargaarsa guddaa godhaniiru. Hawaasni kubbaa miillaa fi kilaboonni isaan dura itti taphatan maatii Messiif gadda isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Madonna pays tribute to 'genius, otherworldly' producer William Orbit
english: Madonna has shared a heartfelt tribute to her longtime collaborator, the Grammy-winning producer William Orbit, following his recent passing at age 69. She credited him for transforming her artistic direction, particularly during their iconic work on her acclaimed 1998 album, Ray of Light. Madonna described their studio sessions as a transformative and spiritual experience that helped her explore new creative depths.
amharic: ማዶና በ69 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት የተለዩትን የረጅም ጊዜ የሙዚቃ አጋሯንና አምራቹን ዊሊያም ኦርቢትን በማስታወስ ልብ የሚነካ መልዕክት አስተላልፋለች። የፖፕ ንግሥቲቱ በ1998 ዓ.ም 'ሬይ ኦፍ ላይት' የተሰኘውን የተሳካ አልበም በአንድነት በመስራት የሙዚቃ ህይወቷን እንደቀየሩት ገልጻለች። ማዶና ከኦርቢት ጋር በስቱዲዮ ውስጥ ያሳለፉትን ጊዜ እንደ መንፈሳዊ ጉዞ በመቁጠር፣ አብረው የሰሩት ስራ የፈጠራ ችሎታዋን እንዳሳደገው ገልጻለች።
oromo: Maadonnaan guddifachaa fi guddifachaa muuziqaa beekkamaa William Orbit, kan umuriin isaa 69 ta'e du'aan darbuusaa hordofee, yaadannoo cimaa isaa ibsiteetti. Isheenis, keessumaa bara 1998 albamii 'Ray of Light' jedhamu irratti waliin hojjechuun isaanii hojii ishee keessatti jijjiirama guddaa fiduusaa yaadatteetti. Maadonnaan yeroo isaan istuudiyoo keessatti dabarsan akka muuxannoo hafuuraa fi uumamaa guddaatti ilaaluun, obbolummaan isaanii dandeettii uumamaa ishee akka guddise ibsiteetti.

title: Which stars need to shine this season: Real Madrid, Barcelona, Man Utd, PSG
english: As European football leagues prepare for the new season, focus is shifting toward the key players expected to drive their teams to success. Star performers like Arsenal's Declan Rice and Manchester United's Bruno Fernandes remain central to their clubs' strategies due to their impressive statistical contributions. With a relatively quiet transfer window, these established stars will be crucial in determining whether their teams can compete for titles this year.
amharic: የአውሮፓ እግር ኳስ ሊጎች ለአዲሱ የውድድር ዘመን ሲዘጋጁ፣ ትኩረቱ በቡድኖቻቸው ስኬት ላይ ወሳኝ ሚና ይኖራቸዋል ተብሎ በሚጠበቁ ተጫዋቾች ላይ አርፏል። እንደ አርሰናሉ ዴክላን ራይስ እና የማንችስተር ዩናይትዱ ብሩኖ ፈርናንዴዝ ያሉ ኮከብ ተጫዋቾች ባሳዩት አስደናቂ ብቃት ለክለቦቻቸው ስልት ማዕከል ሆነው ቀጥለዋል። የዘንድሮው የዝውውር መስኮት በአንፃራዊነት የተረጋጋ በመሆኑ፣ እነዚህ ልምድ ያላቸው ተጫዋቾች ቡድኖቻቸው ለዋንጫ የሚደረገውን ውድድር እንዲያሸንፉ ወሳኝ ይሆናሉ።
oromo: Liigonnii kubbaa miillaa Awurooppaa waancaa haaraaf yeroo qophaa'aa jiranitti, xiyyeeffannaan taphatoota gurguddoo garee isaanii milkeessuu danda'an irratti godhameera. Taphatoonni akka Declan Rice kan Arsenal fi Bruno Fernandes kan Manchester United gumaacha isaanii kan lakkoofsaan mirkanaa'e irraa kan ka'e qindoomina garee isaanii keessatti bakka guddaa qabu. Gabaan jijjiirraa taphatootaa yeroo kana tasgabbaa'aa waan ta'eef, taphattoonni beekamoon kun gareen isaanii waancaa akka argatuuf murteessoo dha.
